records.name: Lasso
records.tagline: Draw on your Mac screen, then let AI agents see it
records.description: Lasso lets you draw arrows, boxes and notes right on your Mac screen with ⌥⇧A, then press S to screenshot what you marked up. Blur sensitive bits, share an encrypted link that expires in 24 hours, or sketch on an endless whiteboard. It also runs a local MCP server, so Claude Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop can see what you circled and draw back. $9.99 once, no account, no subscription. macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel.

records.name: AI Visibility by TruLata
records.tagline: Find out if ChatGPT names your business when buyers ask
records.description: Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude who to hire, and take the answer. Type your website and in about ten seconds see whether AI engines can read it, with every fix spelled out and no email needed. Then watch the engines answer six real buyer questions. Inside TruLata the check runs every week across nine engines, and a blank answer is never scored as a miss.

records.name: 3BCAD
records.tagline: Open-source parametric CAD with built-in 3D print prep
records.description: 3BCAD is a free, open-source parametric CAD app for makers and engineers, written in Rust for Windows, macOS and Linux. Sketch with constraints, build parts with extrude, revolve, sweep, loft, fillet and threads, and change any dimension later. Check overhangs and thin walls, lay parts flat on your printer's bed and send 3MF to your slicer. Put parts together in assemblies with mates, then make 2D drawings with sections and dimensions, exported to PDF, SVG or DXF.

records.name: RankSpot
records.tagline: Pay-as-you-go SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents
records.description: RankSpot is the SEO and AI Search execution layer for agents. Connect the MCP to Claude or ChatGPT in 2 minutes and your agent does the work: it writes articles from what already ranks on Google in 100+ languages, publishes them, and pitches ranking sites from your mailbox for backlinks. Run every client or business from one chat. No subscription: $3 an article, $0.004 a prompt check, reading your data free. Start with $1 of credit and a free article.

records.name: EkLine
records.tagline: AI SEO for Developer Tools and API first companies!
records.description: Your buyers ask ChatGPT which tool to use, then ask Cursor to build with it. EkLine helps your API or developer tool succeed at both. Its AI agents audit your website, docs, GitHub, and community content to find what AI misunderstands or can't implement. Then they prioritize gaps, write code-grounded fixes as pull requests your team approves, and retest AI responses to measure what improved.

records.name: TheBold
records.tagline: Turn execution into meetings with investors
records.description: TheBold turns startup execution into direct investor access. 🎉 Launch Fast Track (Nov 17–27): pass one AI investor-readiness interview, land in the deal flow of investors who match your startup, and unlock direct meeting access. TheBold helps founders understand investor criteria, track and verify execution and traction, practice investor-specific AI simulations, and book meetings once qualified.

records.name: GatherHQ Agent Research
records.tagline: Let your agent take surveys for you
records.description: Join the founding agent research panel. Copy an invite into your agent, pair it, and let it answer relevant surveys using preferences you authorize. Answers distinguish evidence, inference and unknowns. Control profile matching, frequency and revocation. Current beta studies are unpaid; the goal is sponsor-funded rewards for humans. No PII studies or guaranteed earnings. Automatic checks depend on your agent’s host.

records.name: VINC
records.tagline: Bring your filmmaking vision to life.
records.description: You know the scene, the mood, the camera movement, and how your film should feel. VINC helps you work on the rest. Finally, bring all your generated shots into the built-in editor, where SFX and BGM are taken care of, and deliver your final output.

records.name: Liquid d1.2
records.tagline: Decision models that return calibrated probabilities
records.description: Liquid d1.2 and d1.2-ultra are omnimodal decision models that return calibrated probabilities, so low-confidence answers can go to human review. This version adds audio input and five tasks: reading values, finding text spans, locating objects, estimating numbers with a range, and multi-select. Per Liquid AI, d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index, two points above the previous best. On the Liquid API now; OpenRouter and Vercel coming soon.

records.name: Pinecall
records.tagline: The open-source platform for voice AI agents

Test with simulated callers, get every call logged and judged, and keep a person one tap away. On our cloud or your own Kubernetes. Apache-2.0, built on LiveKit.

records.name: Clamor
records.tagline: Turns social signals into actionable insights

records.name: superlog
records.tagline: Finds the production bugs your monitoring never sees
records.description: Your monitoring only alerts on what you told it to watch, so customers still report bugs. Superlog finds the errors nobody set an alert for, investigates them 24/7 and hands you a fix. 100+ startups use it; 87% of our fixes get merged.

records.name: WispOS
records.tagline: Free AI game maker with an app store that wants your games

Ask for anything else and it comes back as something you can see and use. Run several at once, walk away, and she finds you when they're done. Your files stay on your computer.

records.name: infaiw
records.tagline: Delegate work to sidecar agents that pass an approval script
records.description: infaiw is an open-source daemon-first agent harness. Sessions are durable timelines you can branch from any point. Approvals wait for you even after you close the terminal. Switch between DeepSeek, OpenAI Codex, and Claude Code mid-session. MCP servers, skills, evals, and image support built in. One Go binary, under 100 MiB, Apache-2.0.

records.name: Trading Agents

records.name: ShadowDiff

ShadowDiff solves this with zero-latency Envoy traffic mirroring, mathematical 3-way Diffy noise cancellation, database side-effect diffing, and automated regression test synthesis with LLMs.

records.name: HuginnEye

records.description: PitchMender helps B2B product marketing and sales teams check claims in battlecards and comparison pages. Submit a public comparison page or redacted sales text, add official competitor sources, and review claims alongside their evidence and suggested revisions.

records.name: WeSound
records.tagline: Request songs from a live DJ and leave a tip
records.description: WeSound lets the crowd request songs from a live DJ and support them with a tip. Scan the QR, pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay or card, and the tip is only charged if the DJ accepts. Free for guests and free for DJs to sign up.

records.name: GENESIS Revenue Recovery
records.tagline: Organise quotes, prioritise follow-ups, track sales
records.description: GENESIS helps HVAC, solar and service contractors organise unanswered quotes, prioritise follow-ups and track sales outcomes. Try our interactive browser-based prototype with fictional data. We're inviting UK businesses to explore a 14-day assisted pilot.

records.name: Fun Calendar
records.tagline: A new holiday every day, with ideas to celebrate together
records.description: Fun Calendar shows a curious holiday every day, from World Pasta Day to cheese rolling, and turns it into a small plan: for you, for two or with friends. Pick an idea and send a personal invitation as an image or a link friends can open without the app. 809 holidays, including UK and German occasions, plus a Home Screen widget, daily quiz and badges. With Apple Intelligence it can write a plan for your company, time and budget. Free; Pro is optional.

records.name: PULSE
records.tagline: See where your kick and bass fight, then fix it
records.description: PULSE is a plug-in for the kick and bass relationship. A live collision map shows where and when the two fight, with an advisory carve suggestion: which one to cut, where and by how much. A sub sculptor keeps the low end audible on phones, and glue ducks on real kick hits, not level. VST3 on Windows, VST3 + AU on Mac. Free trial, no time limit (analysis only). $49, one-time.

records.name: YT Agencies
records.tagline: Find the right YouTube agency before you pay the wrong one
records.description: Hiring the wrong YouTube agency burns months of budget. YT Agencies is a directory built only for YouTube: compare agencies for ads, SEO, channel growth and production by services, pricing and results, then contact them directly.

records.name: KabexEdge by KabexAI
records.tagline: The crypto terminal that tells you when your edge is luck
records.description: Most trading tools show you a backtest that looks great until you trade it. KabexEdge is a crypto charting terminal that tells you the truth first: the Honest Backtest says whether a result looks like skill or luck, and indicators carry report cards showing how their textbook reading did after fees. 135 indicators, 20 chart types, a practice account, options data and liquidation maps. Our own record is sealed every day and timestamped on Bitcoin.

records.name: Anchor — Porn Blocker
records.tagline: Porn Blocker for Chrome, Edge, Firefox & Windows
records.description: Anchor blocks adult sites, forces safe search, and holds your settings in place for a commitment period you choose. Pro adds on-device AI image filtering. No accounts, no analytics — everything runs on your computer.

records.name: RegionalFlags
records.tagline: Find a flag by country, region or city
records.description: Find a flag by country, region or city. Download available images and copy HEX and RGB color codes.

records.name: Squidbrake
records.tagline: Agents propose. People approve
records.description: Your agents can do more than suggest. Squidbrake lets them ship code, change databases and handle refunds, with a person signing off only where it matters. Routine work runs, risky work waits for approval, catastrophic work is blocked, and every decision lands on a tamper-evident record your auditors can read. Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and MCP.

records.name: Zoho CRM AI Assistant
records.tagline: Ask, search and update Zoho CRM in plain English
records.description: Work with Zoho CRM in plain English: find records, update deals, prepare follow-ups and investigate duplicates from a Chrome side panel. Review changes in Approve writes mode, the default. Or connect supported MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT using their permission prompts. 14-day Plus trial, no card.

records.name: GiftQuest
records.tagline: Wrap a gift in a quest they have to solve to unlock
records.description: Hide a promo code, link, tickets or a file behind riddles, photo puzzles and QR treasure cards. Describe it in a sentence and AI writes the first draft. They solve it on their phone — no app, no sign-up — then unwrap the gift by hand. Free.

records.name: Plumyra
records.tagline: See what X has flagged on your account, in plain words
records.description: X keeps an Under the Hood report on your account that shows if your reach is being limited. Plumyra reads it and tells you which labels you have, which posts are holding you back and what works for you. Free, no X login, never asks for your password.

records.name: BidRidge
records.tagline: Estimates, drawings and signed proposals for contractors
records.description: BidRidge prices jobs from a contractor's own labor rates, production numbers and margin, with Good, Better and Best options and a walk-away price so you stop underbidding. Draw the work to scale in trade designers (tile, cabinets, roofing, decks, drywall and more) and the quantities feed the quote. Customers sign and pay the deposit from a text. Then it builds crew job packs, change orders and invoices. Built by a working contractor in Alaska. Works offline. 14-day free trial.

records.name: Clamor
records.tagline: Turns social signals into actionable insights
records.description: Social data tells you what's happening. Clamor helps you understand why it matters and what to do next. Built by marketers for marketers, Clamor turns social signals into actionable insights. Now it's even easier to: 🔍 Analyze public social accounts without a login 🔮 Explore insights with Ask Clamor, anywhere 💨 Find answers faster with a simpler experience 🛠️ Integrate insights into your tools via API Less time collecting data. More time making smarter decisions. Try the new Clamor today!

records.name: CleanMyShot
records.tagline: Remove false AI badges and metadata, in your browser.
records.description: CleanMyShot runs 100% in your browser — no account, no upload, no server. Photos: removes C2PA 'AI Info' badges, EXIF, IPTC and XMP, with camera grain calibration and a PNG whitelist strip that keeps transparency. Documents: scrubs PDF metadata across every revision, including compressed /ObjStm streams, plus Word/Google Docs metadata. Text: strips zero-width characters, smart quotes, grey paste boxes and AI cliches from ChatGPT copy-paste. Works offline once loaded.

records.name: Templaunch
records.tagline: No-code templates you can edit and deploy in minutes
records.description: Pick a ready-made template (cafes, salons, portfolios, and more), customize the text, images, and colors from a simple sidebar editor, and deploy a live site with one click — powered by Netlify. No code, no design skills needed. I'm still finishing up payments/business setup, so right now you can join the waitlist — the first 50 signups get 40% off at launch.

records.name: PS2 BIOS Download, Setup & PCSX2 Guide
records.tagline: Understand and Set Up PS2 BIOS for PlayStation 2 Emulation.
records.description: PS2 BIOS is a helpful resource for gamers who want to understand PlayStation 2 BIOS files, learn emulator setup, and enjoy classic PS2 gaming on compatible devices.

records.name: quicklabelcrop.co.in
records.tagline: Automated E-commerce Shipping Label Crop Tool
records.description: Quick Label Crop is a free online shipping label crop tool that helps sellers easily crop, resize, and print Amazon, Flipkart, and Meesho shipping labels in 4x6 format. Save time with fast, accurate, and easy label processing.

records.name: Vidoveli
records.tagline: Turn long videos into captioned shorts with AI
records.description: Turn podcasts, interviews, and webinars into captioned shorts for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Vidoveli finds moments that stand on their own, scores them, and explains each pick. Edit clips by changing the transcript, then add animated captions in 40 languages and reframe for vertical video. Start with 60 minutes of video processing free, no card needed.

records.name: AXO Launcher
records.tagline: Change your whole Android home screen, not just the icons
records.description: AXO Launcher lets you change your whole Android home screen, not just the icons. Pick from 16 complete themes, each with its own layout and navigation, from a paper style rail to a dot matrix clock. Several have a calendar, notes, to do list and weather built in. No ads, no trackers and no account. Works on phones, tablets and foldables. 9 themes are free and 7 more come with AXO Pro.

records.name: Keepgoing
records.tagline: Hand off context and code between AI agents
records.description: Keep building when you switch AI agents. Keepgoing preserves your project goals, decisions, progress and code so the next agent can pick up where you left off. Save the current state, share one prompt and approve scoped access. Versioned documents and recoverable files keep work traceable across sessions. Works with agents that support HTTP requests or MCP.

records.name: AiCore
records.tagline: Turn talking-head phone videos into finished Reels with AI
records.description: AiCore turns a talking-head video filmed on your phone into a ready-to-post Reel, TikTok or Short in about 5 minutes. The AI writes a screenplay for your words and adds subtitles in your language (built for Kazakh and Russian), motion graphics, beat-synced music, sound effects and 3 post captions. Your own voice stays. No video yet? It writes a script for its built-in teleprompter. Your first video is free.

records.name: Laplet
records.tagline: Use your Mac or Windows PC from your iPhone or iPad
records.description: Turn your iPhone or iPad into the screen, keyboard and trackpad for your Mac or Windows PC. Half-fold an iPhone Duo and it's a tiny laptop. Real Mac trackpad gestures, QR pairing, end-to-end encryption, no account. Free for one computer on your Wi-Fi.

records.name: Symbol Translator
records.tagline: Type once to see Morse, binary, Wingdings, and hieroglyphs
records.description: Type once and see your message in Morse code, binary, Wingdings, glitch text, Egyptian hieroglyphs, and braille. Paste any of those symbols back into the same box and the detector translates them into English.

records.name: Scanevol
records.tagline: Now with digital menus and event tickets
records.description: New since our first launch: a digital menu guests open in one scan, which you can also put on your own website, and event ticketing. Sell tickets on your own site with one line of code, then check guests in at the door with any phone. Plus everything from before: QR codes you can edit after printing, scan stats, a free QR and barcode scanner, a Chrome extension, a barcode label app and a REST API with webhooks. Free plan, 14 languages.

records.name: Smart Scraper Studio
records.tagline: Paste a website link, get every business and email in Excel
records.description: Paste a directory or website link: the AI finds the list, opens every page and saves businesses, websites, phones and checked emails to Excel, CSV or JSON. Runs on your PC, no per-row cost. Free trial: 500 rows.

records.name: Minimal Subscription Tracker
records.tagline: Minimal Notion tracker for your subscriptions and renewals
records.description: A simple Notion template to track all your subscriptions. Log the service, monthly or yearly cost, and renewal date. Mark each one active or inactive. Good for keeping your budget in check without a cluttered setup. Easy to tweak to fit how you work.

records.name: Owed: Promise Tracker
records.tagline: Who you owe, who owes you, and a polite way to follow up
records.description: Owed keeps two ledgers: what you owe and what's owed to you. Capture a promise by voice or text in English or Arabic, get nudged at a good moment, and send a ready-made follow-up via WhatsApp or Mail. Free, no subscription, no account.

records.name: Scroll Goblin
records.tagline: Catch a pixel goblin before Instagram opens
records.description: Pick the apps you scroll too much. To open one, catch a pixel goblin. Catches buy 1, 3, 6, then 12 minutes and he gets faster each time. When time's up, the app closes itself. Free for one app. No account, no tracking. iPhone, iPad and Android, 10 languages.

records.name: Swivly for Google™ Accounts
records.tagline: Every Google link, in the right account
records.description: Signed in to several Google accounts? Swivly opens every Google link in the right one. Open Gmail and pick an account on a dial; the pick sticks across Google for 15 minutes. Shared Docs, Sheets and Drive files open in the account that has access, checked in about a second. Links clicked in Gmail open in that inbox's account. Hold an account in the toolbar to open Drive, Docs or Meet in it. Free, no sign-up, and nothing leaves your browser.

records.name: SilentSale
records.tagline: The UK resale marketplace that protects buyer and seller
records.description: SilentSale is a UK marketplace for preloved clothes, tech, homeware and kids' items. Instead of protecting just one side, buyer and seller each pay the same small SilentCover amount (£0.30 + 3%), so both are protected equally. Stripe holds the payment until the buyer confirms delivery, or shares their PIN at an in-person PIN Pickup. Listing is free, sellers can add short videos, and payouts go to a UK bank. Live on iOS, Android and the web.

records.name: MightyWatcher
records.tagline: Website change alerts you describe in plain English
records.description: Paste a link, describe what you're waiting for ("alert me when this drops below $50", "tell me when size 10 is back in stock"), and pick how often to check, from every 30 minutes to once a month. AI reads the page on each check and emails you a short summary when your condition is met. No CSS selectors, scripts or browser extension.

records.name: Facade UI
records.tagline: Interactive floor plans and React blocks for realtor sites
records.description: Facade UI is a shadcn registry for real estate and local business websites. Start with the interactive floor plan: buyers tap a room and see size, finishes and features right on the plan, on desktop and phone, with keyboard support. Pro adds listing grids, a mortgage calculator, a valuation funnel and 5 complete Next.js site templates with live demos. MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor. 35 items free, Pro is $149 once.

records.name: Dexibi
records.tagline: Your voice. Your computer. The work gets done.
records.description: Meet Dexibi - an AI operator for your Windows desktop. Instead of switching between apps, menus, and prompts, tell Dexibi what you want to accomplish. It can interpret your instructions, use supported desktop tools, interact with applications, and help carry out multi-step workflows through voice. From everyday computer tasks to developer workflows, Dexibi is being built to turn natural instructions into real actions. Your voice. Your computer. The work gets done.

records.name: CERTILUM
records.tagline: Master certification exams. Don't memorize them.
records.description: Accelerate your IT and project management career with Certilum. The most advanced marketplace and diagnostic engine for professional certifications.

records.name: Roavi
records.tagline: Now a community of locals
records.description: Roavi connects travelers with verified Local Friends for real, local experiences in cities across Latin America and Southeast Asia. Ask questions, get tips from people who live there, and message them directly. Free for travelers.

records.name: Type War
records.tagline: Competitive Typing Tests, Battles & Challenges
records.description: Typewar is an ai-built typing platform that makes typing practice feel like a competitive game. Test your speed and accuracy, challenge yourself with different game modes, climb ranked leagues and compete in weekly tournaments. Features include sudden death, target mode, accuracy only, daily challenges, ai opponents, ranked matches and global leaderboards. Built with ai, manually tested and continuously improved. free to play for anyone who wants to improve their typing while having fun.

records.name: Pluna
records.tagline: Your bridge to the right AI tools, step by step
records.description: Thousands of AI tools launch every day. Pluna learns them for you, picks the best ones for your goal, and builds them into a simple step-by-step plan. AI is only as good as its user. Pluna is the bridge between you and AI.

records.name: DataLab Audit
records.tagline: White-Label Instagram Reels Intelligence for Agencies
records.description: Turn any prospect's last 15 public Reels into a branded retention scorecard, 15-day action plan, and 10 ready-to-shoot Hook-Body-CTA scripts in 30 seconds. Built for marketing agencies—zero client passwords required.

records.name: Proofsheet
records.tagline: Click-to-edit portfolio website for Windows
records.description: Proofsheet is a small Windows app that opens your portfolio website and lets you edit it by clicking on it. Click a headline and type, double-click a photo to swap it, Alt+click a link to change it, duplicate or remove projects, then save. It comes with a clean one-page portfolio template and publishes to Vercel with one button, or you can upload the files anywhere. Pay once, no subscription; your site is plain files you own. Windows 10 and 11.

records.name: The Ultimate WebGL Studio Bundle
records.tagline: 11 premium WebGL & GSAP templates for high-end brands.
records.description: Stop settling for flat, static storefronts. This bundle gives founders and developers the exact front-end architecture used by top-tier creative agencies to build immersive 3D brand experiences. Includes 11 premium, production-ready website templates engineered with GSAP animations and spatial WebGL environments at a fraction of a custom $10k+ build.

records.name: diploma.ba
records.tagline: Credentials you can trust. Verification without borders.
records.description: diploma.ba helps educational institutions, academies, and training providers issue secure digital certificates. Every credential can be verified instantly through a unique link or QR code, with blockchain-backed document integrity.

records.name: Vetoo
records.tagline: Low-noise AI code review that adapts to your team
records.description: AI code review that adapts to your team. Set up in minutes, integrates seamlessly into your existing workflow, and needs no ongoing configuration. Vetoo reviews across repositories, pulls context from your third-party tools, and learns from your team's feedback. You can talk to it just like you would with a teammate: discuss its findings, ask questions, or leave feedback. The result is precise, low-noise reviews, so you merge faster with fewer bottlenecks.

records.name: Don't Let Me
records.tagline: The screen time blocker where your buddy holds the key
records.description: Every other screen time app lets you turn the block off yourself. DLM doesn't. Pick the apps that pull you in, set the hours, and pair with a buddy: a partner, a friend, anyone who'll hold the line. To unlock, you write down why, wait out a short cooldown, and your buddy decides on their phone. Changing your blocks or your schedule goes through them too. Your blocked list never leaves your phone. iPhone, 3-day free trial.

records.name: PEARSPECTIVE
records.tagline: Business software for photographers
records.description: Desktop app for photographers that finds the venues, events and brands who need photos, writes each pitch in the photographer's voice, and handles proposals, contracts, deposit invoices, calendar and galleries.

records.name: Meow Bubble Spinner
records.tagline: Cozy Cat Shooter, Spin to Win
records.description: Every shot turns the board. Clip the edge of the cluster and it spins. Line up the right colour, cut the right link, and a whole branch of bubbles comes crashing down at once. Each shot is two moves: what you pop now, and what you turn into place for the next one. Easy to learn in one shot. Hard to stop thinking about.

records.name: Archon
records.tagline: A new way for teams to work with AI
records.description: Archon is the AI that knows your business and works for everyone in it. Everyone has their own Archon. The team shares a Library of what it knows. Agents made for a job do real work and bring it back for a person to approve. People keep the judgment and the final say. A chat assistant answers one person and forgets. Archon reads the team's Library and each person's notes before it works. It does the work with proof, learns every correction, and runs work on a schedule.

records.name: Export iCloud
records.tagline: Save your whole iCloud Photos library in original quality
records.description: A Windows and Mac app that downloads your entire iCloud Photos library to your computer or an external drive as original files. No 1,000-item limit, no full sync. Optionally delete each item from iCloud once it's saved. Free for 200 files a month.

records.name: Book A Santa Call
records.tagline: Live AI Santa video calls kids can take from home
records.description: Book a 7-minute live video call with a lifelike AI Santa from home. Parent books and stays nearby. Santa knows your child's name and wishes. US$20 / CA$28 per child (early bird US$15 / CA$21 until Nov 30). Christmas Eve, Day & Boxing Day. No app.

records.name: Declone
records.tagline: Find fake clones and lookalike domains of your website
records.description: Scan 500+ lookalike domains and Certificate Transparency logs, compare live sites with yours, and spot active clones. Free in about 90 seconds, no signup. Launch offer: use OFF75 for 75% off your first month of Daily Radar.

records.name: COR5
records.tagline: Know before you train: readiness, response and recovery
records.description: COR5 is a handheld and wearable multi-sensor wellness device for athletes. Take a quick readiness check before you train, see how your body responds during and after, and compare every result with your own baseline. Not a medical device.

records.name: SwipeQ
records.tagline: Bite-sized knowledge instead of endless feeds + a quiz
records.description: I'd scroll Instagram for an hour and couldn't name one thing I'd seen. SwipeQ keeps the swiping but makes it count: short cards on topics you pick, like ancient Egypt, the history of the internet or 90s pop culture. After every few cards there's a quick quiz on exactly what you just read, so it actually sticks. Keep a streak, climb weekly leagues or compete in a group with friends. 700+ topics are free, 5,500+ facts and questions in total. iOS and Android, English and German.

records.name: BeCullab
records.tagline: Hire Indian creators with contracts and safe payments
records.description: Brands post a project once and verified Indian creators apply. Chat, offers and signed agreements happen in one place, creators get a 50% advance, and payment is released on approval. Agencies run all clients from one account. Free to join.

records.name: Mix Chat
records.tagline: Meet people from around the world by shared interests
records.description: Mix Chat helps adults meet new people through shared interests and chat in real time. Explore a world map of who's on the app in each country, see who's online now, share photos, and stay safe with blocking, reporting and automated moderation. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: MyRadioBox
records.tagline: 80,000+ live radio stations, playing right from your toolbar
records.description: Listen to 80,000+ live radio stations from 114 countries without keeping a tab open. Search by name, browse by country, save favorites, and control playback from the toolbar or your system's media controls. Free, no account needed.

records.name: DealsRadar
records.tagline: Curated Real Price Drops & Loot Deals Tracker
records.description: Verified price drops, budget tech finds under ₹199 and ₹499, and genuine shopping markdowns without inflated MRP scams.

records.name: UncoverAI
records.tagline: The Enterprise AI Briefing
records.description: UncoverAI is an independent research initiative tracking AI models, enterprise platforms and market signals, auditing changes in legal terms, compliance and security. Built for CTOs, CIOs, CISOs and enterprise AI leaders. 47 models, 21 platforms, source-cited.

records.name: Tidecast
records.tagline: Offline tide times and the best time to hit the beach
records.description: Tidecast tells you when to go: tide, daylight, wind and waves at your beach, for clamming, tide pooling, surf fishing or a walk. Tides are computed on your iPhone, so they work with no signal. US and France. No ads, no tracking.

records.name: STT
records.tagline: Free, open source offline dictation app for Mac
records.description: STT (Speech to Text) is a free, open source dictation app for Mac. Press a keyboard shortcut, speak, press it again, and the text lands in the app in front. Runs offline with Whisper, Parakeet or Qwen. No history, no logs, no account.

records.name: Self Love: Daily Affirmations
records.tagline: Daily affirmations that don’t track you, ad you or sell you
records.description: Self Love is a calm daily affirmations app for iPhone. Pick the topics you need, get a gentle reminder at the times you choose, and make it yours with themes and icons. No account, no tracking, no ads. Free to use, with an optional upgrade.

records.name: PenPal
records.tagline: GLP-1 tracker, rebuilt: meal scores, streaks & doctor report
records.description: PenPal 2.0 rebuilds the friendly GLP-1 tracker: a penguin pal that reacts to your day, streaks and 50 achievements, a widget, a dose card with site map and supply, protein and fiber scores from a meal photo, and a doctor-ready PDF.

records.name: CoreA11y PDF Accessibility Checker
records.tagline: Check if your PDF is accessible for free, then get it fixed
records.description: Upload a PDF and see what blocks screen reader users: missing tags, title, language, unembedded fonts and more, checked against PDF/UA and WCAG 2.2. Free, nothing to install, no AI. Want it fixed? See the exact price first, from $0.63 a page.

records.name: Kick Champ
records.tagline: Real 3D free kicks for your country. Free, no ads.
records.description: Kick Champ is a free 3D free-kick football game for Android. Swipe to shoot, curl the ball round a goalkeeper who dives, tips and punches, and watch every goal again from four angles. Your striker wears your country's colours as you climb global and country leaderboards. Four modes plus a 12-level World Tour. No ads, no real-money purchases, plays offline.

records.name: Spendwise
records.tagline: Private, offline expense tracker for Android
records.description: An offline-first personal expense tracker. Log spending, set monthly budgets, manage recurring bills, keep a group ledger for a trip or a shared home, and track who owes what — no account, no cloud sync, all stored on your device.

records.name: iBeauty
records.tagline: Salon finance for lash, nail and brow artists
records.description: iBeauty is salon finance for lash, nail and brow artists. Log each visit against a real client with the services you sold, and see which services actually earn. A client book with private photo galleries, a priced catalogue, recurring costs, wallets for tax and savings, and reports that answer real questions. No booking and no calendar: just the money side. Web, iPhone and Android on one subscription, and the first month is free.

records.name: hearlog
records.tagline: Transcribe, translate & subtitle Indian languages with AI
records.description: Transcription built for how India speaks. Upload audio, video or a YouTube link and get accurate transcripts in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bangla, Hinglish and 50+ languages, in native script. Get AI summaries and action items, translate, export time-synced SRT subtitles, organise recordings in folders and chat across them. Free: 300 min/month.

records.name: LoreNext
records.tagline: Web3 publishing & private clubs where creators earn forever
records.description: LoreNext is a decentralized publishing and private community platform built on Base. Creators issue tradable Access-Right Passcards for serialized fiction, comics, and articles — earning primary sales, ongoing secondary royalties, and algorithm-free Creator Clubs.

records.name: Free Apple Gift Card Giveaway Win $3,000
records.tagline: Free Apple Gift Card Giveaway: Win $3,000
records.description: Open to Argentina, Indonesia, Turkey, Vietnam, the USA, Canada and Germany. Enter free for a chance to win $3,000. Not affiliated with Apple.

records.name: First Adopter
records.tagline: Find people already asking for your product
records.description: Paste your website and get real people from the last 30 days asking for a product like yours, on Reddit, HN, Stack Exchange, Bluesky and forums. Each lead links to the post, says if you can reply there, and comes with a reply draft. First report free.

records.name: Best Headphones for Music
records.tagline: Headphones ranked by how many real owners recommend them
records.description: A headphone leaderboard with no reviews and no paid spots. We screened 88,909 public comments and 13,749 store reviews, then counted how many real people recommend each of 31 pairs. Every number is a count you can check, and the complaints are shown too.

records.name: Personal Injury Lawyer – Lake Oswego OR
records.tagline: Serious Injuries Representation in Lake Oswego
records.description: Hurt in Lake Oswego or Portland metro? Select Law represents people injured in car, truck, motorcycle, bicycle and pedestrian crashes, slip and falls, and dog bites. We deal with insurance companies and fight for full damages. Free consult. No fee unless we win.

records.name: WispOS
records.tagline: Free AI game maker with an app store that wants your games
records.description: Free to use, open beta, on Mac and Windows, with iPhone and Android apps. Describe the game you want to Wisper, in your own words. She hands it to the AI you bring, and you get it back to play. Ask for changes and play it again. No engine needed, but engine compatible: bring your Unity or Unreal project too. Ask for anything else and it comes back as something you can see and use. Run several at once, walk away, and she finds you when they're done. Your files stay on your computer.

records.name: Liquid d1.2
records.tagline: Decision models that return calibrated probabilities
records.description: Liquid d1.2 and d1.2-ultra are omnimodal decision models that return calibrated probabilities, so low-confidence answers can go to human review. This version adds audio input and five tasks: reading values, finding text spans, locating objects, estimating numbers with a range, and multi-select. Per Liquid AI, d1.2-ultra scores 75 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index, two points above the previous best. On the Liquid API now; OpenRouter and Vercel coming soon.

records.name: infaiw
records.tagline: Delegate work to sidecar agents that pass an approval script
records.description: infaiw is an open-source daemon-first agent harness. Delegate work to sidecar agents that must pass an acceptance script before they can report "done" — the parent decides what done means, not the model. Sessions are durable timelines you can branch from any point. Approvals wait for you even after you close the terminal. Switch between DeepSeek, OpenAI Codex, and Claude Code mid-session. MCP servers, skills, evals, and image support built in. One Go binary, under 100 MiB, Apache-2.0.

records.name: Batmail
records.tagline: Your Gmail inbox, handled overnight by your own rules
records.description: Since our August post: Google verified Batmail's Gmail access after a full CASA security review (November 2026), Batmail is now on the Google Workspace Marketplace, Night Shift has a 7-day free trial, the free plan previews your first night on one inbox, and a free phishing checker reads any suspicious email. Batmail is an AI assistant for Gmail. Write rules in plain English and it archives, labels and stars your mail overnight, then sends one short brief each morning.

records.name: NounQuest - Learn Vocabulary
records.tagline: Learning Vocabulary from own language, using images.

records.name: FileConvert

Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android (Beta).

records.name: Readwright
records.tagline: EPUB, MOBI & AZW3 in your browser - real pages, private
records.description: Drop an EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 or CBZ and read with warm paper and real page turns, not endless scroll. The shelf remembers where you stopped; search, highlights, notes, and read-aloud from any sentence. Free, no ads; books stay on your computer.

records.name: Lvji

records.description: Lvji keeps the apps you choose locked until you finish today's movement goal. Four sports free, all eight with Pro. Reps counted on-device. No account, no cloud, no ads. Finish the contract, unlock the day.

records.name: KI-Mentor

records.description: ScoreBoard runs a free 10x10 squares board for every NFL and NBA game. Pick squares on your phone, numbers are drawn automatically at kickoff, and the board scores itself live each quarter. No printing grids or pulling numbers from a hat. Free to play, 21+.

records.name: Machinence
records.tagline: Find your customers, get a sales plan and every tool to sell
records.description: Machinence gives SMEs 26 AI tools in one login. From £3.25 a day, with a 7-day free trial and no card.

records.name: Vira
records.tagline: Planning, focus and feelings for teens with ADHD
records.description: Vira is an iPhone app for teens and young adults with ADHD. Plan your day, focus with a timer and check in with how you feel, all in one place. Viri, a small purple buddy, keeps you company and never tells you off. The essentials are free.

records.name: Doorstep
records.tagline: A daily word ladder. One letter at a time, get to HOME.
records.description: Doorstep is a free daily word ladder. You get a four-letter word and change one letter at a time until it becomes HOME. One new puzzle a day, the same for everyone. No account and no download. When you finish, you see the shortest route and can dare a friend to beat you. There is also a cat.

records.name: TrackMyPaw: Dog Walk Tracker
records.tagline: GPS Walks, Routes & Care Log
records.description: TrackMyPaw is your whole pack's companion for walks and care - add all your dogs, record every adventure with GPS, keep meds, feeding, and health in one caring place, and discover pet-friendly places around you.

records.name: Scale190
records.tagline: Use your previous Meta ads data to generate better creatives
records.description: Stop wasting your Meta ads data, use it to make better creative decisions. Scale190 remembers what happened in your ad account. It breaks down creatives to figure out how a winning creative is structured based on component-level data. Powered by AI that learns constantly from your campaigns, it auto-tags every video creative and generates high-performing new ads based on those learnings. It also notifies you instantly when ad fatigue hits, performance drops, or you reach your KPI targets.

records.name: My House, My Things
records.tagline: A record of your house, on iPhone and Mac. Bought once.
records.description: A record of your house for iPhone and Mac: the rooms and places, the things in them, what each cost and when the warranty ends, and the jobs that come round, from the boiler service to the gutters, with what you did and what it cost each time. Dates and costs typed the way you'd say them, read back before they're added. Photograph the rating plate, scan the receipt. Kept in step by your own iCloud, with no account. £19.99 / $19.99 once, for both.

records.name: Storewalk.ai
records.tagline: Find out if AI shopping agents can buy from your store
records.description: AI shopping agents don’t browse like humans - and most online stores aren’t built for them. Storewalk scans your store and shows you exactly where an AI agent would stop: whether it can find your products, compare them, complete a purchase, or handle what comes after. Every scan runs some checks, produces a Ready score out of 100, and delivers a fix list that names who should act and how much effort each fix takes. Includes a free consultation with every full report

records.name: CiclIO
records.tagline: Booking, POS & digital contracts for rental businesses
records.description: CiclIO is an all-in-one management and online booking platform for equipment and experience rental businesses. Track unit-level inventory, accept 24/7 bookings, collect e-signed PDF contracts, and handle deposits with 0% booking commission. 14-day free trial (no card required).

records.name: Wutch.tv
records.tagline: Track what you wutch
records.description: Wutch.tv is a free TV show and movie tracker with every feature free for everyone. Track shows and films, see Up Next, a release calendar and spoiler-blurred episodes. Get stats, achievements, reviews and community polls, plus an API and MCP server for AI assistants. Works on any device as a PWA in 5 languages. No subscriptions, no paywalls, supported by donations.

records.name: Vetted
records.tagline: An app store for AI-built apps, each one tested by AI

Before any app goes live, an AI tester opens it, signs up like a real person, uses the main features, logs out and back in to check things saved, and tries it on a phone. Apps that pass go live. Makers get a plain-English report plus a fix they can paste into their AI builder. No downloads, no app store fees, free to list.

records.name: Haste Trading L.L.C.

We stock compressors, condensing units, refrigerant gas, copper coil, controls, gauges, fan motors and tools for contractors, AC and cold-room technicians, supermarkets and industrial sites.

records.name: Freemoji
records.tagline: Find any emoji and copy it with one tap. No ads.

Deploy to 7 cloud providers, the App Store and Google Play, then bill clients through your own Stripe account with fixed fees or subscriptions. Everything you need to build, launch and run an agency in one platform.

records.tagline: Notes, tasks and flashcards in one shared space
records.description: Real-time collaborative notes, made in Spanish. Write with blocks, see every open task from all your notes in one agenda, study with spaced-repetition flashcards and turn any note into slides. Free, in your browser.

Free minutes to start, then one-time minute packs instead of a subscription.

records.name: Ceramide Moisturizer

Ideal for compromised, dehydrated, or reactive skin.

Free, no ads, no limits on the tools themselves.

A body map shows which sites have rested; reminders are scheduled by your phone. No ads, analytics or tracking in the app. For personal tracking only: not a medical device, and it does not recommend doses.

records.name: Rockxy
records.tagline: Open-Source debugger for API, AI and Web3 traffic on Mac

Find the failing request, replay it, compare responses and test the fix with breakpoints and mapping. Free Community mode.

records.description: Storilo is one calm place for everything you want to read: saved articles, your own PDFs and books, or free classics. Tap any word for its meaning in your language and a ✦ note on what it means in that sentence. Listen on a walk with read-aloud, keep words with the sentence they came from, and get saved reading back with a gentle reminder. On Plus, ask a book a question with no spoilers. No streaks, no leaderboards. Free to start; Plus and Pro add more AI, voices and room.

records.name: Kippy
records.tagline: Type it, say it or snap it without leaving your app.
records.description: Kippy is a small capture layer for your Mac. From any app, press ⌃⌥N to type a thought, hold ⌃⌥K to say it, or ⌃⌥4 to snap the screen and draw on it, then carry on. Kippy keeps where each one came from, sees whether it's a task, a reminder or an event, and brings it back when it matters: on the edge of your screen, in the app it belongs to, or in a Daily Brief read aloud. It records meetings too. No account and no cloud: everything stays on your Mac.

records.name: Confetti Magic
records.tagline: Throw confetti across your screen, even on video calls
records.description: Celebrate any win with one shortcut: confetti, fireworks, snow or emoji rain across your whole Windows desktop, over every app and every monitor. Shipped a feature, closed a deal, finished a sprint, or made it to Friday? Press Alt+Shift+D. Share your screen on Teams, Zoom or Google Meet and everyone on the call sees it. Pause before you present; pick your colours and emoji sets. No account, no tracking. Free 7-day trial, then $4.99 once. A free Chrome extension does the same in your browser.

records.name: Sayw
records.tagline: Instagram comment-to-DM automation with AI follow-up
records.description: Send a guide or link by DM when someone comments a keyword on Instagram. Answer follow-up questions with AI, reply personally from the inbox, and keep customer notes in CRM. Connect Claude or ChatGPT through MCP to set up automations and manage leads. Free plan available.

records.name: UNTIL
records.tagline: Day, month, year and life left. Now on iPhone.
records.description: UNTIL keeps day, month, year and life progress on your home screen, Lock Screen and widgets, so you see what is left without opening another productivity app. Now on iPhone. Also on Android, Wear OS Day %, and a Mac/Windows menu-bar companion. Free core forever. Premium unlocks more surfaces.

records.name: ArcMD
records.tagline: Native WYSIWYG editor for local Markdown files with Spaces.
records.description: A fresh take on Markdown: a fast, native rich-text editor built in Go with MyGo. Inspired by Arc, with colorful spaces, split views, and local-first notes.

records.name: RevOdo
records.tagline: Private Mileage & Expense Tracker for Independent Drivers
records.description: Track business mileage and receipts without GPS surveillance or cloud accounts. Export CRA & IRS-ready tax reports in seconds—100% stored on your device.

records.name: RPGadget
records.tagline: One home for every tabletop RPG campaign
records.description: RPGadget is a desktop toolkit for Game Masters on Windows. Bring in the rulebook you own for any RPG. RPGadget sorts your whole rulebook and makes it searchable. Nothing added, nothing removed. You are in full control. Build your world, its people and places, plan your campaign, and run the night from one desk. Your players join from their phones in any browser, at the table or across the country. Your books stay on your own PC. Try the free demo before you buy.

records.name: Badie
records.tagline: Find a badminton game without asking strangers
records.description: I was too shy to ask strangers at the gym for a game, so I built Badie to do the asking for me. Tell it when you're free and which courts you can get to, and it goes looking for people who play about as well as you do. Nobody's locked in until everyone says yes. There's a 2-minute level quiz you can try without an account. You can also see who's free on a given day or join a weekly group. If someone doesn't show up, it stays on their profile. Free, no ads. Web and iPhone.

records.name: Trovefold: Private Records
records.tagline: Life records, custom fields, and reminders in one place
records.description: Keep document details, subscriptions, warranties, account information, and family records together, with reminders attached to the details they belong to. Build records with custom fields, organize them in Boxes, and bring calendars and reminders into Scenes. Use encrypted fields for sensitive values and review Capture suggestions before saving. Start free; Plus adds Shared Boxes and higher limits.

records.name: Getman
records.tagline: The free, open-source Postman alternative, built in Rust
records.description: Getman is a free, open-source alternative to Postman. Every request is a plain YAML file in your repo, so API changes get reviewed in the same pull request as the code. Send them from the desktop app, your phone, a browser, the terminal or CI. HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/3, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE and Socket.IO. Import your Postman collections and most pm scripts run as they are. Free for any team size, with no account, no per-seat plan and no telemetry.

records.name: Orexa Downloader
records.tagline: Free, open-source download manager that never loses progress
records.description: Orexa Downloader is a fast, free and open-source download manager for Windows. It splits files across 8 connections, resumes after drops, and waits out servers that go down. Catch downloads from Chrome, Brave or Edge, save web videos and whole playlists, and download torrents with no extra setup. Switch a stuck download to a mirror, verify files with checksums, limit speed, and schedule downloads for the night. In English and Arabic.

records.name: Short Drama Script
records.tagline: Turn one twist into a 10-episode short drama script.
records.description: Short Drama Script turns one premise into a 10-episode outline for vertical short drama. Pick a genre, a main character, and a twist. In about 20 seconds you get a title, logline, character bible, season arc, and 90-second beat sheets with a hook and cliffhanger for every episode. The first 3 episodes are free. Unlock all 10 episodes and a PDF for $4.99 once. No account, no subscription. Built for ReelShort, DramaBox, TikTok, and the writers and producers testing ideas before production.

records.name: Storage Cleaner for ChatGPT
records.tagline: Bulk-delete the files clogging your ChatGPT storage
records.description: ChatGPT's Library keeps every file you've uploaded, and when storage fills up you can only delete them one at a time. Storage Cleaner lists every file largest first, shows how much documents, images and audio/video take up, and lets you filter, search or select everything older than 90 days, then batch-delete with a live progress bar. Deleted files stay restorable for 30 days. Runs entirely in your browser: no accounts, no servers, no data collected.

records.name: Loopee
records.tagline: Seamless video loops and AI video editing, in the cloud
records.description: Loopee is an AI video studio in the browser. Studio turns short clips into loops with no visible jump at the restart: its agent picks the loop point and fades the end into the start. It also makes boomerangs, upscales, resizes and exports MP4, MOV or GIF at a target file size. New since our first launch: Director, a chat-based AI video editor. Describe an edit or a new animation and it plans, builds and checks the result. Pay as you go, no subscription.

records.name: Practitioner Protocols
records.tagline: 1-tap product routines for service-driven brands
records.description: Clinicians (physios, dermatologists, trainers, vets) recommend products during appointments, but clients forget names and buy on Amazon. Practitioner Protocols gives specialists one permanent link or printable QR handout to send clients directly to a 1-tap cart at normal retail price. Built for Shopify brands with aggregate sales attribution and strict Zero-PII privacy. 100% free and open-source (MIT).

records.name: HyperTrail
records.tagline: Every AI coding session, from every agent, in one place
records.description: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and 22 more agents each keep their history in a different hidden folder. HyperTrail puts every session in one searchable place on your Mac, with what it changed, what it cost and the command to resume it. Live usage limits too. Read-only, no account.

records.name: Verbatimly
records.tagline: Transcribe video to text in under a minute
records.description: Drop in an MP4, MOV, MKV, or audio file and get a timestamped transcript back in under a minute. The video never gets uploaded - your browser pulls out the audio track and sends only that. An 8-minute interview comes back in about 14 seconds. Click any line to jump to that moment. Assign speaker labels. Export TXT, SRT, or VTT. Share a link that plays the audio alongside the transcript. Free: 1 file a day, up to 30 minutes each, no account. Credit packs ($3/$9) take files up to 120 minutes.

records.name: ChineseKit
records.tagline: Free Chinese dictionary with stroke-order practice and HSK
records.description: A free Chinese–English dictionary for learners. Look up characters and words by hanzi, pinyin or English, then see meanings, HSK level, radicals and components, plus step-by-step stroke order with writing practice. No sign-up.

records.name: SignThis
records.tagline: E-signatures sealed for proof, with palm-verified signers
records.description: SignThis is electronic signatures you can prove. Send a PDF; signers open an email link and sign in a browser, no account needed. Every finished document is sealed with a digital signature and a trusted timestamp, and anyone can verify it without uploading the file. On paid plans, require each signer to pass a palm scan in the Very app before their signature counts. REST API, webhooks and an MCP server for AI agents. 3 documents a month free, no card.

records.name: AVault
records.tagline: Private call recordings, kept on your Android
records.description: AVault by HumNod gives call recordings a private home on Android. Keep audio in an AES-256-GCM encrypted vault, unlock with a PIN or biometrics, search your library, bookmark recordings, and choose automatic cleanup. Free with source on GitHub. Shizuku is required; no root needed. For lawful research and consent-based use. Compatibility varies by device.

records.name: Kepton
records.tagline: Private notes from conversations, all on your iPhone
records.description: Kepton listens to a conversation you're part of and writes down what matters: what was promised, what was decided, and where you agree. Transcription and analysis run on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence. Audio is never saved, there is no account, and the app makes no network requests. Three sessions are free, then a one-time purchase.

records.name: Dialect
records.tagline: Give the physical world an API
records.description: Point any camera at something you'd otherwise walk over to check: a bay, a shelf, a valve, a door. Say what to watch in plain English. Dialect's agent sets up a typed endpoint with nothing to train, keeps reading it, and serves the answer over REST, MCP and webhooks, with alerts. When it isn't sure, it says so instead of guessing. Your first answer is free; $99 a month covers your first thing.

records.name: HawkEye
records.tagline: Website Uptime Monitoring & Alerts
records.description: HawkEye watches your websites, APIs, cron jobs and DNS records, and tells you the moment something breaks. Alerts go to email, Slack, Teams, Discord, Telegram or a webhook. Multi-step API checks sign in and test a whole flow, passing values from one step to the next. SSL certificate and domain expiry warnings arrive before anything lapses. Publish status pages for your customers, and manage it all from Claude through HawkEye's MCP server. Start free.

records.name: Chef Social
records.tagline: Get found. Get busy. Restaurant videos, made and posted
records.description: Your phone clips become posts that reach hungry people nearby and keep regulars coming back. Chef Social learns your restaurant, plans the month, edits videos and photo posts, and posts them to TikTok, Reels, Shorts and Facebook every week. Built by the owner of a restaurant marketing agency. From $59 a month, no contract. Love it or get your first month back.

records.name: polyroom
records.tagline: Where AI agents work together and your team decides
records.description: Where your agents work together and your team decides, wherever each agent runs. Claude Code, Codex and other supported MCP clients join one shared room with your team. They claim cards, mention each other and bring decisions to the people who approve them. Each agent keeps running where it already runs. The shared workspace includes chat, kanban boards and recorded decisions.

records.name: Markd Day Counter
records.tagline: Count the days that matter. Private, open source, no ads.
records.description: Mark a date and Markd counts since it (a sober streak, an anniversary) or until it (a trip, a deadline), live to the second. Set your own milestones and get one quiet notification on the day, with no streaks, badges or gamification. Categories, notes, a calendar, light and dark themes, encrypted backups. No account, no ads, no analytics. Free and open source (MIT), on Android and Windows, in English, Czech, German and French.

records.name: pushr
records.tagline: iPhone push alerts from any script, server or AI agent
records.description: Send a push to your iPhone from any script, server, cron job or AI agent with one HTTP request. No SDK. Orders, payouts, deploys and outages land in one feed, each with its own logo and color. Live Activities for long jobs, replies from the Lock Screen, alarms that ring until you acknowledge them, plus uptime and heartbeat monitors. Free plan, Pro when you need more. The backend is open source (MIT) and self-hostable.

records.name: GeneLab
records.tagline: Turn your raw DNA file into a full health report
records.description: GeneLab turns the raw DNA file you already have from 23andMe or AncestryDNA into something you can actually read. Upload it once and get a full report: how your body responds to common medications, research outcomes tied to your own variants, an interactive 3D genome view, an ancestry breakdown, and an AI layer that connects traits across your genome. No new test and no spit kit. The analysis is ready in minutes and your data stays yours.

records.name: Yaad-e-Namaz
records.tagline: Free, ad-free prayer times, Quran & WhatsApp namaz reminders
records.description: Yaad-e-Namaz helps Muslims pray every salah on time and make up missed ones. Prayer times for 380+ cities using each country's own calculation method, Qibla compass, the full Quran with Urdu and English, the major hadith books, duas, tasbeeh, a qaza tracker, and WhatsApp reminders. Halqa lets family and friends read together toward one goal, like 1 lakh Durood or a Quran khatam. Works offline. No ads, ever, in the app.

records.name: Ridian
records.tagline: The AI-first scheduling suite for everything around meetings
records.description: Ridian is an AI-first scheduling suite. Booking pages with payments, waitlists, groups and teams. Funnels that ask the right questions and send every lead to the right call. A built-in CRM where every booking and funnel answer lands. Calendar and contact sync across Google, Microsoft, iCloud and more. Connect all your calendars and inboxes and let Claude, ChatGPT or Alvin handle it out of the box. You can even give your agents their own mailbox. Everything around your meetings, handled.

records.name: Thastock
records.tagline: A second opinion before you buy any stock
records.description: Type any US ticker and get an AI analysis in about 10 seconds: the strongest bull case, the strongest bear case and a verdict, with the numbers behind them (RSI, moving averages, earnings beat rate, insider buying/selling, analyst consensus) and the latest news. Then set price, RSI or volume alerts and get an email or push the moment they trigger. Also: insider trades, screener, earnings reminders, portfolio import. Free plan; Pro from $9/mo.

records.name: Webdesly Garage
records.tagline: Fleet, valuation and service for collectors and dealers
records.description: Quiet fleet desk for collectors and dealers: vehicles with purchase and valuation, service due, and a Today board to close maintenance. Not a classifieds site, not a marketplace. Free Maison Garage Demo, no signup.

records.name: Octoprox
records.tagline: Open-Source Self-Hosted Proxy Manager
records.description: One endpoint for proxy clients and tunnelled devices over cloud instances, proxy provider sessions and static lists, with IP attribution, traffic limits and billing. No need to maintain different integrations with proxy providers. If a provider is not supported, you can add it to the system using YAML or through a UI wizard. It's particularly useful to people who deal with web scraping. You can also build a personal VPN service that lies on top of proxy providers or cloud instances.

records.name: Firmlock
records.tagline: iPhone app blocker with no End button in strict mode
records.description: Two common complaints in app blocker reviews: blocks that quietly stop working, and blocks you can turn off in a second. A Firmlock strict session has no End button, and until it finishes, apps can't be deleted and the clock can't be changed. Schedules start and end by themselves, even when Firmlock is closed. Websites you pick close in every browser. For extra friction, keep a QR key in another room or let a friend hold your Screen Time passcode. No account, no ads.

records.name: SetLatch
records.tagline: Privacy requests, handled for every client site
records.description: SetLatch handles privacy requests (DSARs) for every website an agency runs. Each client site gets its own request form. Every request gets the legal deadline for where the person lives (GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA and other US state laws), a checklist, and look-ups in the tools the site already uses: Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot and more. Nothing is deleted until a person approves it, and every step lands in an exportable audit trail. From $29/mo per site, 14-day trial.

records.name: SumHatch
records.tagline: Free math and finance calculators, without an account
records.description: Plot functions, adjust sliders, check tables, share graphs, and export PNGs with SumHatch Math. SumHatch Finance estimates loans, mortgages, compound interest, SIPs, EMIs, and fixed deposits, with US and India editions. Each calculator explains its assumptions and includes worked examples. Free to use, with no account required.

records.name: Hobby AI
records.tagline: Track card prices and your collection, free forever
records.description: Hobby AI is a free price guide and collection tracker for trading cards. It catalogs 17 card games, including Pokémon, One Piece, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Disney Lorcana and Riftbound, in English, Japanese and other Asian editions. Every priced card has a daily market estimate averaged across marketplaces, price history and weekly movers. Track unlimited collections, share them, set price alerts and get a monthly value report by email. Free forever.

records.name: Corral
records.tagline: Every Claude Code session, local and cloud, in one window
records.description: Running Claude Code in several repos at once and losing track of sessions? Corral finds every one: in your terminals, on your servers over ssh and in the cloud on claude.ai. It groups them by repo, branch and worktree, so you see where each one works and which ones are waiting for you. Answer permission prompts from the overview, queue the next message while Claude works, review diffs, and find any past session by what was said in it. Free and open source.

records.name: Mynotes
records.tagline: Private web & PDF notes, highlights, and files
records.description: Mynotes is a local-first Chrome extension for saving and annotating webpages and PDFs alongside your own notes, images, and files. Organize everything with tags and search, keep it on your device by default, and optionally sync through your own Google Drive.

records.name: JustHeal
records.tagline: Helping Hands, Healing Hearts
records.description: JustHeal by VitaCasaHealth connects families, hospitals, and clinics with in-home nurses and caregivers, and helps caregivers find real work near them. For Patients and Families: post your care needs in minutes and get matched with caregivers. Review candidate profiles, discuss shift details, and choose who's right for your family.

records.name: Docup
records.tagline: AI Documentation Generator for GitHub Repos
records.description: Connect a GitHub repo and Docup writes your docs, then keeps them true. Each push updates only the pages it touches. Pages you edited by hand are never overwritten: they get a suggestion you accept or dismiss. Everything is a private draft until you publish. Your docs go live as a fast, searchable site with dark mode, Ask AI for readers and llms.txt. Free for the outline and 3 pages.

records.name: Balancdle
records.tagline: Guess the weight. Find the perfect balance.
records.description: How good is your intuition about the weight of everyday objects? Balancdle is a free daily browser puzzle where you position real-world objects on a scale and try to achieve the perfect balance. Each day brings five new rounds, from familiar household items to unexpected objects. Estimate their weights, adjust their positions, and see how close you can get to a perfect 100% score. No downloads or account required. Just five daily challenges and your intuition.

records.name: AI Gladiator
records.tagline: Train an AI gladiator with trivia, then send it to fight
records.description: AI Gladiator is a free browser game where you raise an AI fighter. Every Training question goes into its memory, so it answers better in battles vs the computer and in real-time PVP. Watch it solve mazes, chat with it, and unlock skins. Plays on any phone.

records.name: Feedqube
records.tagline: Turn your notes into scheduled social posts
records.description: Feedqube brings content ideas, drafts, and scheduled posts together in one calendar. Save ideas as notes, draft posts yourself or with Claude, then review and schedule them across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and six other networks. Built for creators and small teams who want to plan a week of content without copying drafts from one app to another.

records.name: aiSecurityWarden
records.tagline: Human approval gate for your AI agent's secrets and actions
records.description: aiSecurityWarden is a zero-knowledge secrets manager with a human approval gate for AI agents. Your agent asks before it uses a secret — you approve, deny, or deny with feedback from your phone. Nothing runs, no credential released, until a human says yes.

records.name: TheToolsBank
records.tagline: Free browser tools for SEO, images, text and more
records.description: TheToolsBank is a set of free online tools for SEO, images, text, developers and everyday tasks. They run in your browser, need no signup, and nothing you add is uploaded or stored.

records.name: Pyra
records.tagline: Know how your business is doing in minutes
records.description: Pyra explains your business numbers in plain words: are you making money, what are your biggest risks, what to fix first. Compare with your sector and simulate a loan before you ask for one. Made in Cali for SMEs and accountants. First analysis free.

records.name: OpenMapp
records.tagline: A free map of US BJJ gyms, open mats, and drop-in prices
records.description: OpenMapp is a free map of US Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gyms with published weekly schedules. As of November 13, 2026, it lists 1,367 gyms in 664 cities, 1,104 open to class drop-ins, and 964 with an open mat. Search by city or ZIP for class times and the visitor drop-in price when the gym publishes one. Unknown prices stay unknown. Gyms cannot pay to rank higher. Add https://www.openmapp.com/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, or Cursor to ask where to train. It never books or pays on its own.

records.name: Promptise
records.tagline: The first framework for agentic systems, not just agents
records.description: Promptise is the first open-source, full-stack framework for agentic systems. Build the agent, the MCP servers it works with and the runtime that runs it on its own, within your controls and policies. Free, on any model, no lock-in.

records.name: Highreel
records.tagline: A personal year in review for every customer
records.description: Give every customer a personal year in review: their name, their numbers from your spreadsheet, your logo and look. Each Highreel is a short story of slides they can save and share. Send it from your own email or domain, your newsletter tool, one link or WhatsApp, and see who opened it. One price per campaign, not per customer: from $99 for up to 1,000.

records.name: Slicess
records.tagline: AI-generated decks you can edit down to every word
records.description: Describe your deck, attach PDFs, docs or images, and press Generate. Slicess reads your files first, picks a professionally designed look that fits your topic, writes into the design's own text boxes and paints new pictures into its photo frames. You get real slides, not pictures of slides, on a canvas editor where every word, image and color can be changed. Edit any slide with AI, present, share a link or export a PDF. Free plan included.

records.name: Gantry
records.tagline: Every Apple container command, as a native Mac control
records.description: Apple's container tool runs Linux containers on Apple silicon, and it has no window. Gantry is that window: containers, images, Compose projects, Kubernetes clusters, builds and logs, next to your Docker hosts on this Mac or over SSH. Each container command has a control. A built-in MCP server lets Claude and other agents use the same controls. Free, open source, MIT licence. macOS 26 or later.

records.name: MakeGig
records.tagline: Brand Discovery & Outreach for UGC Creators
records.description: MakeGig helps UGC creators discover brands that fit their content, find the right contacts, and send personalized AI-powered pitches.

records.name: ScholarVerse by Whole Living Academy
records.tagline: K-12 Interactive Pan-African Curriculum
records.description: Planning engaging, culturally relevant school days takes time. ScholarVerse helps homeschooling families and educators with ready-to-use K–12 learning centered on the African American experience and wider African world. Explore complete school days, interactive lessons, educational games, virtual labs, coding, flight simulations, and progress tracking. Perfect for homeschooling, afterschool enrichment, and independent learning. Start with a free Daily Quest at myscholarverse.com.

records.name: seshka
records.tagline: Kill what Claude Code left behind
records.description: Claude Code sessions end. The dev servers, watchers and scripts they started don't. seshka shows them in your menu bar, grouped by session, with memory and ports. Kill them in one click. End idle sessions too, by hand or automatically. Free and open source.

records.name: DiscoverMyDog
records.tagline: Guess what your dog will do, then find out
records.description: Think you know your dog? Bet on it. DiscoverMyDog gives you tiny two-minute experiments to try together: hide a treat, offer a toy or a snack, yawn and see if your dog catches it. You guess first, try it, then record what really happened. No training, no special gear. Each one comes with a short note on the idea behind it, and over time the app builds a picture of who your dog really is. 800+ discoveries. Free to start on iPhone.

records.name: GDPR Server Tracking MCP
records.tagline: Manage your server-side GTM trackers by chatting with AI
records.description: Connect your AI assistant to your GDPR server-side tracking. GDPR Server Tracking MCP lets Claude, Cursor and VS Code create and monitor your server-side Google Tag Manager trackers on EU bare metal. Sign in once to check tracker health, stats and credit usage, or resize and manage trackers after you confirm. It only sees settings and stats, never your visitors' events. Included with every GDPR Server Tracking plan.

records.name: TapTidy
records.tagline: Your keyboard. Every language. Zero typing stress
records.description: An iPhone keyboard for multilingual messages. Fix spelling and grammar, review the suggestion, and choose what to replace without leaving your chat. Includes 10 free corrections a day and optional Premium.

records.name: ratio.photo
records.tagline: Free aspect ratio calculator for photo, print, and crop.
records.description: Free aspect ratio calculator and converter for photo, print and crop: find pixel dimensions by ratio, megapixels or print size, with presets for social, photo, print, film and screens.

records.name: Move-Out Packet
records.tagline: Deposit packets landlords can defend, plus free state tools
records.description: Landlords lose deposit disputes for missing proof. Move-Out Packet guides dated photos room by room, links each charge to its proof, and builds the deposit statement as one PDF before the deadline.

records.name: SaleTick
records.tagline: Run your shop from WhatsApp: sales, stock and invoices
records.description: SaleTick helps small shops record sales, track stock and send receipts and invoices on WhatsApp. Stock updates with every sale, with low-stock and expiry alerts, barcode scanning, profit reports, staff roles and multi-branch support. Works online and offline on Windows, Android and iOS. Import records from Excel or photos of a paper book. 2-month free trial.

records.name: Visual Explorer
records.tagline: Design Inspiration: Websites, Apps, Logos and Motion
records.description: A curated Archive of design inspiration where every piece is chosen by a human editor and credited by name to the person who made it.

records.name: Fade to Color
records.tagline: Every film as its colors. Browse, scrub and guess them.
records.description: Fade to Color turns thousands of films into movie barcodes: every frame averaged to one color and lined up from the opening shot to the credits. Swipe through them, hold one to scrub scene by scene, or see it as rings, ripples or a reel. Then play: name films from their colors alone, play the same five as everyone each day, or start a film club with friends. Make any film your wallpaper, or leave it on display. Free, with no ads or in-app purchases.

records.name: Transinaut
records.tagline: AI that finds, checks and explains your HS codes
records.description: Transinaut classifies goods for customs. Describe a product or send a photo: the assistant reads the official national tariff, asks the one question that separates two candidate codes, and returns the code, why it fits and the codes it ruled out. Then, where the tariff supports it: landed cost, import requirements, anti-dumping duties by origin and past customs rulings. 12 tariffs incl. Morocco, EU, UK, US, Canada, UAE and Saudi Arabia. Free plan, no card.

records.name: OpenState
records.tagline: Session memory and guarded edits for AI coding agents
records.description: AI coding agents forget decisions between sessions and sometimes edit the wrong code. OpenState records actual session events; decisions, failed commands, blockers, and test outcomes; into a local project record. It restores context automatically in OpenCode, shares summaries with Claude Code and Codex through MCP, and previews structural edits before applying them. All 36 tools are free to explore; the first 30 structural applies per machine are free.

records.name: Lifeboat
records.tagline: Mac backup that proves your files can be restored
records.description: Lifeboat backs up your Mac on a schedule to a disk, a NAS or your own S3 bucket (R2, B2, AWS, Hetzner). Once a week it restores 200 random files from the newest backup and compares each one byte for byte with your Mac. The status turns green only after a passed check. Built on restic: encrypted on your Mac with AES-256, open format, readable without Lifeboat. Free for one disk, Pro €39 once for 2 Macs.

records.name: Statpio
records.tagline: White-label hosting with forms, stats and a client portal
records.description: Statpio hosts your clients’ websites under your brand. Put static or AI-built sites live on their own domains with free SSL; forms are captured automatically with no backend, and analytics are built in. Clients sign in to a portal with your logo to see leads and traffic, get reports and request changes. One bill instead of three tools: 30 client sites for $99 a month. Run it all from a dashboard, or from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor over MCP. Free plan; Agency Pro free for 7 days.

records.name: EveryApp
records.tagline: Every app you need. Even the ones that don't exist.
records.description: EveryApp puts 300+ free tools, apps and games in one place: edit PDFs, photos and video, track habits and bills, play 70 games. Every app opens on the web or installs on your phone or computer. Can't find the app you want? Describe it in your own words and we build it for you, with its own web address, for you and the people you invite. No coding. The era of personal apps is here: software made for one person, not for millions.

records.name: Income Refinery
records.tagline: See how much of your spending passive income already covers
