records.description: Income Refinery is a free, private, browser-based passive income and dividend tracker built for income investors and the FIRE community. Track dividends, rental income, bonds and every passive stream in one unified dashboard, and measure your progress toward financial independence in real time.

records.name: roko browser
records.tagline: Super Fast & Distraction Free Browser for iPhone
records.description: Get to what you came for, without the wait or the pop-ups. roko opens in 160 ms, loads pages up to 5x faster than Safari in our tests, and clears ads, trackers and cookie pop-ups before the page draws on 99% of the top 9,000 sites. Pull down to summarize a page, or ask and it reads the web for you, with Apple's on-device AI or your own API key. One bar also takes voice and to-dos synced with Reminders. No account, no tracking. Free on App Store.

records.name: Superclip
records.tagline: Clipboard history and a smart notch for Windows
records.description: Superclip brings clipboard history, music controls, video, focus tools and AI usage into a compact Windows notch or side panel. Find copied text, links, images and more without hunting through windows. Your clipboard history stays on your PC. One-time purchase; Mac version coming soon.

records.name: Second Look
records.tagline: Buy, negotiate or walk away on any listing, in one click
records.description: Second Look is a Chrome extension that checks any online listing before you buy. Open a used car, phone, laptop or sofa, click once, and in about 10 seconds you get a verdict: buy, negotiate or walk away. It shows the fair price vs the asking price, scam red flags, the real cost of owning it, questions to ask the seller and a ready-to-send offer. Works on Marketplace, eBay, Vinted, Craigslist and any shop. 3 free checks, no sign-up.

records.name: Skiss
records.tagline: Save websites with their fonts, colours and real CSS
records.description: Skiss saves a website the way it looked the day you found it: full-page screenshots on desktop and phone, plus its colours, fonts and sections, read from the code. Search your library, compare versions, and let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Figma design from it.

records.name: Mr.Speech
records.tagline: Turns your meetings into action. Now with agents.
records.description: Mr.Speech records your meetings on your computer, with no bot in the call, and turns them into a plan you approve. New in this launch: agents. Connect Gmail, Calendar, Slack, Notion and dozens more, then ask Mr. AI for the follow-up. It reads the meeting and your notes, prepares the email, calendar entry or message, and waits for your click. Nothing is sent without it. macOS, Windows and Linux, with a free plan.

records.name: UI Raptor
records.tagline: Inspect live websites like design files.
records.description: UI Raptor is a free Chrome extension for inspecting live websites like a design file. Explore layers, layout, styles and CSS in familiar panels. Measure with rulers and guides, adjust a grid overlay’s columns directly on the page, and use X-Ray to reveal its structure. Pick colors, check contrast, preview screen sizes and explore fonts, tokens and assets. Pin comments to elements, then copy CSS or feedback with context for developers or coding agents. No account or payment required.

records.name: Bezzle
records.tagline: A whole design studio, free, on your Mac and PC
records.description: Remember when you owned your design software? Bezzle brings that back, and it costs nothing. It runs on your Mac or PC, opens your Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD and Photoshop files, and does the whole job: components, prototypes, hand-off, dark mode in one click, live co-editing, animation, vectors, cutouts and photo edits. One app where you used to need four. No subscription, no account, and nobody counting your seats.

records.name: CodaDNS
records.tagline: DNS filtering for your family's devices
records.description: CodaDNS helps families manage DNS filtering from one account. Configure supported devices with the setup guides and review DNS activity. Filtering applies to domain requests; it does not read chats, track location or measure screen-time minutes. See the website for current platform and plan availability.

records.name: Smartconnect Linux
records.tagline: Motorola Smart Connect but for Linux
records.description: Open-source Smart Connect for Linux, built with Rust. Features an enhanced GTK4/libadwaita interface, delivering a polished, fully native desktop experience with Windows Companion-level functionality and an improved user interface.

records.name: GlimsePlatform
records.tagline: Find people, businesses and services anywhere, or be found
records.description: Search for people, businesses, suppliers and creators worldwide, or ask any question and get an instant AI answer. Publish a free profile with all your social links, use image search to verify photos, and connect safely through built-in messaging.

records.name: GrowPython
records.tagline: The AI Operating System for Client Acquisition
records.description: GrowPython finds the right people, reaches them on LinkedIn and email, handles replies, books meetings and keeps the notes, all in one workspace. Xupy, your AI teammate, drafts and plans; you approve every send. $25 per seat per month, 5-day free trial.

records.name: 1PM Workout
records.tagline: Become the next One Punch Man (or 9 other anime heroes)
records.description: A hyper-minimal workout app that takes you from 10 reps to 100, one level at a time. Pick from 10 anime themes, train in small sets with a rest timer, and tell it when a workout was too hard so the level repeats instead of climbing. It keeps your history, streak and rank, and rest days don't break the streak. Free, no ads, no sign-up needed, works offline. Now with an MCP server, so Claude or ChatGPT can log your workouts. No stress, just steady progress (and maybe bald, in a good way :D)

records.name: devpack
records.tagline: 455+ free dev and everyday tools, in one tab or your AI
records.description: 455+ free tools in one tab: compress images, merge PDFs, run SEO audits, format JSON and more. Most run in your browser, so files never leave your device. New: use 40 tools inside Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via MCP. No sign-up.

records.name: WooCommerce Skill Games & Rewards
records.tagline: Skill games and coupon rewards for WooCommerce
records.description: Run playable campaigns in your WooCommerce store. Invite shoppers to dodge obstacles, guide a snake, or hit targets. Set who can play, where the invitation appears, which scores earn coupons, and how much to spend. Preview campaigns before going live and track participation in WordPress. Dodge Rush is free. Premium adds Snake Challenge, Target Master, and business exports.

records.name: NowsGood
records.tagline: Know When Friends and Family Are Free to Talk
records.description: Stop wondering if now is a good time to call. NowsGood lets friends and family share when they’re free to talk, so you reach people at the right moment, even across busy schedules and time zones. Tap once to show you’re available, add a timer or short message, and see who’s free before you call. Sort contacts into groups like Family or Close Friends, choose who sees your status, and get notified when someone is free. Weekly schedules update your status for you. Free, with no ads or data selling.

records.name: Immortal Brains
records.tagline: Free resume builder with templates for 100+ job titles
records.description: Free courses and articles on software and AI, and a free resume builder with templates for over 100 job titles.

records.name: Designrail
records.tagline: Turn any website into a DESIGN.md your AI agents follow
records.description: Designrail turns any website into a design system your AI coding agents follow: it reads the live page, writes DESIGN.md, SKILL.md, Cursor and Copilot rules and Tailwind tokens, then checks your build against them. It's a Chrome extension for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Codex. Free: DESIGN.md and a Claude Code skill. Pro: every export, whole-site scans and a live check that underlines off-system styles on localhost. Page content never leaves your browser.

records.name: FirstTake
records.tagline: Make complete films with an AI agent on your Mac
records.description: FirstTake turns a film idea into a finished MP4 on your Mac. Its AI agent plans scenes, generates shots, adds voices and music, edits and exports. See the model and estimated cost before paid steps. Use the built-in agent or connect Claude, Cursor or Codex through MCP. Normally $9 once for a lifetime licence and updates. Product Hunt: $5 for the first 50 buyers with FIRSTTAKEPH. Bring your own provider keys; generation is billed separately.

records.name: Number Jungle
records.tagline: A math runner for kids, built by a dad and an AI agent
records.description: Number Jungle is an endless runner where kids answer by running into the lane with the right answer: addition, subtraction, times tables and division for ages 5 to 10. Sums they get wrong come back more often, and a report shows parents what to practice. It is free, with no ads, no in-app purchases and no account, works offline and comes in 10 languages on iPhone, iPad and Android. I'm a dad, and I built it for my two daughters in a few weeks with an AI coding agent.

records.name: DropPad: File Shelf
records.tagline: Shake a file, get a shelf. Screenshots and copies land there
records.description: DropPad is a shelf for your Mac. Shake a file while dragging and a box appears: park files, switch folders, drag everything out at once. New screenshots and everything you copy land in a box too. 14 days free, then a one-time €2.99.

records.name: Set Recorder Pro
records.tagline: Multitrack recording off a USB DJ mixer to an Android phone
records.description: Plug your Android phone into a DJ mixer and record the main mix plus every channel as its own file at the mixer's own rate and bit depth. No laptop. Tested on Pioneer DJM-A9, DJM-V10, DJM-750MK2 and XDJ-XZ. Free to try, one-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: Post your build ideas
records.tagline: Launch your product free — one email, no account, no queue
records.description: A free launch board for builders. Post your product with one email — no account, no waiting list, no paid placement, ever. Launches are ranked by votes only, with daily, weekly and all-time boards, comments and a discuss forum. Launch straight from Claude Code or Cursor through our free MCP server. Out of ideas? Browse a board of app ideas people will never build, each with a ready-to-paste build prompt.

records.name: Qorivel
records.tagline: You did a lot this week. What actually mattered?
records.description: Qorivel is a private weekly reflection coach. Check in for about a minute a day, in words, not scores. At the end of the week it reads your week back to you in plain language: what you did, what stood out, and your next steps for the week ahead. It notices patterns without judging them. Your first 5 weekly reports are free. Available on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: Patchd: Video FX Playground
records.tagline: Live camera FX: 2,000+ shaders you stack & share
records.description: Turn your camera into art. Swipe through live camera FX, wear face masks, and put a color, shader, photo or video behind you with Green Screen. In FX Maker, mix 2,000+ shaders in up to 8 layers, then share your FX: every FX works on both iPhone and Android. Free on the App Store and Google Play.

records.name: Rooko
records.tagline: Learn English words through funny stories in your language
records.description: Every English word gets a sound-alike in your own language, a short silly story and a picture. To a Spanish speaker "water" sounds like "Walter", so Walter is the guy who is always thirsty. About 2,900 words (A1 to B2) have stories for Spanish, Turkish, Azerbaijani and Russian speakers, with recorded pronunciation. You also add the words you met in real life each day, and spaced-repetition games bring them back.

records.name: ERPHub Dynamic
records.tagline: Describe your business, get your own ERP
records.description: ERPHub Dynamic builds an ERP from a description of your business. Start with ready Invoicing, Sales, Purchase, CRM, Inventory, Projects and HR apps, then ask the AI builder - in English or Arabic - for new apps, fields, workflows, approvals and dashboards. Each company gets its own subdomain and private PostgreSQL database. Dynamic MCP lets you ask Claude or ChatGPT about your live data. Not Odoo: our own engine. Free plan, Pro $19/month.

records.name: VibeSlip
records.tagline: Turn your Spotify stats into aesthetic thermal receipts
records.description: VibeSlip turns your Spotify, Apple Music or Last.fm stats — plus goals, memories, trips and inside jokes — into realistic thermal receipts, tickets, boarding passes, newspapers and polaroids. Pick from 20 templates and 16 paper themes, remix any slip with AI, then export a 4K PNG, print-ready PDF or animated 9:16 reel for TikTok, Reels and Stories. Free to start, no login needed for manual mode.

records.name: AI Metadata Ninja
records.tagline: Strip AI metadata from images — free, in your browser
records.description: Free AI metadata remover for images and video. Scans C2PA, XMP, EXIF, IPTC and AI prompt traces, then removes them at the byte level — no re-encoding, no upload, no quality loss. Runs entirely in your browser.

records.name: WatchWithMe
records.tagline: Watch Netflix, Prime & more in sync with your partner
records.description: A free watch party browser extension for couples. Sync Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Hulu, Crunchyroll, YouTube and more with your partner, wherever you are, with built-in voice, video and text chat. Friends are welcome too.

records.name: Sirio
records.tagline: Every coding agent. One native window
records.description: Sirio is a native desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and Oh-My-Pi side by side, in terminals and chats for every git worktree, with a code editor, language servers and your pull requests beside them. Open source under the MIT licence, written in Rust on gpui.

records.name: GenioPlay
records.tagline: Turn what you study into a game.
records.description: Ever had a test coming up and a child who just won't read the chapter one more time? GenioPlay turns those exact pages into a game. Take a few photos, and a minute or two later your child can play level 1 of a game on that topic, with guardians to beat. Or pick a ready-made game for math, logic, biology or geography. Free to start, no ads, nothing to install.

records.name: Eyebrow
records.tagline: Your MacBook notch, finally doing something
records.description: Eyebrow turns the notch into a live strip for music, volume, downloads, timers, meetings and Claude Code, and opens into a shelf, clipboard history and 18 widgets. Free on the Mac App Store; Pro is a one-time $4.99 with a 3-day trial.

records.name: Draksy®
records.tagline: Quotes, invoices, website and shop in one place
records.description: Running a small business is brilliant. The admin around it, not so much. Draksy keeps it all in one place: your website and online shop, leads and customers, quotes and invoices, card payments, calendar and reminders, expenses and mileage, and your email. Built for sole traders and small teams who want their evenings back. Made in Cornwall. £24 a month with a 30-day money-back guarantee. Available in the UK now, with the USA and New Zealand coming soon.

records.name: Manifestation Coach – Find Your Blocks
records.tagline: A free 15-minute coach that finds your blocks
records.description: Manifestation Coach is a free coach that helps you find what's blocking your goal in a 15-minute conversation, then writes affirmations in your own words. No sign-up needed.

records.name: ReturnPass: Returns Tracker
records.tagline: Every Amazon return numbered, every refund tracked
records.description: Stuck at the counter, scrolling for the right QR code? ReturnPass gives each Amazon return a short number, like R4. Write it on the box or bag. At the counter, tap the number and the QR code is there. Returns are grouped by where they drop off, you get a reminder the day before one is due, and you can see which refunds haven't arrived. Someone else dropping off? Send them the codes. They don't need the app. iPhone only. First 3 returns free, then $39.99 a year. Not affiliated with Amazon.

records.name: Meeting Notes & Action Items AI
records.tagline: professional follow-up emails in seconds
records.description: Transform meeting transcripts into clear summaries, action items, decisions, risks, and professional follow-up emails in seconds.

records.name: DwellZero
records.tagline: Last Free Day alerts for containers, before demurrage hits
records.description: DwellZero tracks the Last Free Day, holds and availability of containers at 162 port and rail terminals in the US and Canada, and alerts you before demurrage. Pay per container, first 10 free every month.

records.name: Dormant
records.tagline: Put old projects to sleep. Wake them on cd.
records.description: Dormant archives the node_modules,venv and build folders of projects you've abandoned, and restores them byte-for-byte the moment you come back.

records.name: Skillwala
records.tagline: Use AI to build a side income: freelancing, video, business
records.description: Skillwala teaches you to use AI to earn on the side. Live, beginner-friendly classes on Google Meet, in Hindi and English, show you how to start freelancing, become an AI-powered video editor, launch your first online business or grow the one you have, with ChatGPT, Canva, CapCut and more. No coding needed. Mentors from Meta, Amazon and Cadence. Start with a ₹28 live class and build a side hustle that moves you toward financial freedom.

records.name: InvoicePilot
records.tagline: Get paid without the awkward part
records.description: InvoicePilot sends automatic, tone-aware follow-ups on your unpaid invoices, so you stop chasing clients. Public UPI pay pages, flat ₹799/month, zero transaction fees.

records.name: TayGway
records.tagline: Stop getting scammed in China. Know the local price.
records.description: Photograph a product at a Chinese market: TayGway finds its real local price and gives you the words to haggle in Mandarin. 2 free scans.

records.name: GlobTrek
records.tagline: One Tab Travel
records.description: Globtrek is an all-in-one travel platform that makes seeing the world simple and affordable. From budget-friendly flights and personalized itineraries to dinner reservations, accommodations, activities, and more, we handle every detail in one place—because everyone deserves the opportunity to explore the world.

records.name: LiveFaceSwap
records.tagline: Real-time face swap in your browser, no GPU needed
records.description: LiveFaceSwap turns your webcam and one reference image into live AI video. Try Face Swap, Restyle or Try-On, and see the result as you move and talk. It runs in the browser with cloud processing, so you can start without a dedicated GPU or local models. Capture the studio output in OBS for streams. New accounts start with 10 free credits.

records.name: LicenseManagerPro
records.tagline: Keep every software license and key in one place
records.description: License Management for Mac, iPad and iPhone. LicenseManagerPro keeps software licenses, activation keys and subscriptions under control — native macOS, iPadOS and iOS app. One-time purchase, no subscription, local storage with optional iCloud sync.

records.name: Lpdfi Compress Image
records.tagline: Shrink a photo to the exact KB a form asks for
records.description: "Photo must be under 100 KB." Add your photo, tap 20 KB, 50 KB, 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB or 1 MB (or type any size), and download. In our test a 5 MB phone photo came out under 100 KB. Also: make photos 25–90% smaller, a Website preset and a Save storage preset. Up to 30 photos at once, format kept, and every retry starts from your original. Runs in your browser: nothing is uploaded. Formerly LovePDFi.

records.name: Figa
records.tagline: Plan recurring bills months ahead, no bank connection
records.description: Figa is a planner for recurring bills and expenses. Add rent, subscriptions, insurance, installments and yearly renewals once, then see every month ahead: what is paid and what is still to pay. Forecast variable bills like electricity from past prices, share a workspace with your household or team, and connect AI assistants through MCP. No bank connection needed. Free plan included.

records.name: Bytewize
records.tagline: System design, one byte a day
records.description: A five-minute lesson and one question a day, taken from failures and trade-offs in real platforms.

records.name: LocalFlow
records.tagline: Free offline dictation for Mac that cleans up what you say
records.description: Tap Caps Lock (or any hotkey), talk, tap again. LocalFlow pastes clean text wherever you type, with ums and false starts gone, lists as lists and file names in backticks. Speech (whisper.cpp small.en) and cleanup (Qwen 2.5 7B) both run on your Mac: no account, no cloud, no telemetry. It never answers what you dictate, so prompts for AI agents come back as prompts. Free for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13+, with 5.2 GB of models downloaded once.

records.name: Apex Habits
records.tagline: A vision board that links every picture to a habit
records.description: Make a vision board from your own photos or the free Unsplash library, then link each picture to the habit that gets you there. Four layouts, Lock Screen wallpapers, Story sharing and printing up to 18 × 24 in. A monthly check-in walks through each goal and its habits. Free on iPhone, no account needed.

records.name: Letterslot
records.tagline: A file autopilot for Mac with on-device AI
records.description: Letterslot watches Downloads, Desktop or any folder, reads new files on your Mac and files them by your rules. It recognizes invoices, receipts, contracts and screenshots with Apple's on-device model plus a pattern check for amounts and dates. Describe a rule in one sentence, check it in a dry run, and every action lands in a journal with Undo. Unsure results wait for you. No cloud AI, no account. Free plan; Pro is €24 once for 2 Macs.

records.name: AetherWave VoxBot
records.tagline: One chat for music, video, images and launch pages
records.description: VoxBot is the AI assistant inside AetherWave Studio. Ask it anything, research with sources, then make the thing: songs, videos, images, landing pages and press kits, in the chat. Every paid step shows its price first. Free daily messages for every member.

records.name: Deliobot
records.tagline: AI coworkers that finish real work on your chosen model
records.description: Deliobot gives you AI coworkers that complete real tasks, not just chat. Delegate reports, emails, quotes, support replies and social posts. Connect your email, calendar, files, spreadsheets and CRM. Let Delio Auto choose a model, pin one per bot, or bring your Claude or ChatGPT account, API key or local model. Automate routines and approve important actions from your phone.

records.name: Ferrata Labs
records.tagline: Make your enterprise AI-native
records.description: Ferrata Labs builds enterprise AI agents for finance and ops, layered on top of SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics, or CRMs. Agents start with approval gates and become autonomous functions as your confidence grows, with a first agent live in under 12 weeks.

records.name: Decor Pact
records.tagline: Home Decor Ideas & Inspiration
records.description: Discover beautiful home decor ideas, stylish room inspiration, and practical decorating tips to create a cozy, comfortable, and beautiful home.

records.name: Severn Planner
records.tagline: Free School Planner for Students
records.description: Severn Planner is a free school planner for students, made as an independent student project. It syncs assignments and grades from Canvas, Blackbaud, Schoology, and Google Classroom, brings in assignments from Brightspace, Moodle, Blackboard, ManageBac, Toddle, and Veracross with a calendar link, and schedules study sessions into free time.

records.name: Pry
records.tagline: Prove your app is exposed, not just suspicious.
records.description: Pry proves an app you own is exposed by actually trying the exploit, then captures a signed, replayable proof. Ownership-gated, read-only by default. No pattern-matching verdicts, no 'secure' claim.

records.name: SiteSnag
records.tagline: Snag a property and send the PDF report before you leave
records.description: SiteSnag is a snagging and punch list app for inspectors, surveyors and new-build buyers. Take a photo, pick the room and the wording from a library of 460+ defects, and the camera stays open for the next one. Pin every snag on a floor plan, mark up photos, then send a branded PDF report from site. No account, works with no signal, and your surveys stay on your iPhone or iPad. Yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: Workbook Handover Professional
records.tagline: Trace Excel formula impacts before making changes
records.description: Workbook Handover Professional helps you understand Excel workbooks you didn't create. Inspect worksheet structure, explore detected formula references across sheets, and trace possible downstream effects before editing. Build a change-review record and export HTML/JSON reports. Runs locally in desktop Chrome or Edge with standardxlsx files up to 20 MB; no workbook upload or subscription. One-time purchase: $9.90. This is a rules-based aid, not a complete audit or repair tool.

records.name: Repo-Radar
records.tagline: Understand any GitHub repo in one click
records.description: Repo Radar is a free, open-source browser extension that scores any GitHub repo in one click. Open a repo, click the icon, and a side panel shows a letter grade with where it lost points, activity and bus factor, known dependency vulnerabilities (OSV.dev), and a clickable import diagram in 10 languages. Compare two repos side by side, or watch one and get alerted when its grade drops. No server, no tracking, no AI deciding the score. Works in Chrome, Edge and Firefox.

records.name: TinoCall AI Receptionist
records.tagline: 24/7 AI Receptionist for Cleaning Businesses
records.description: TinoCall is a 24/7 AI voice receptionist for residential and commercial cleaning businesses. It answers inbound calls in English and Spanish, checks service-area ZIP codes, quotes only owner-approved pricing, books directly into Google Calendar or Cal.com, and emails instant call summaries.

records.name: Waggle
records.tagline: One inbox for every decision your AI agents need
records.description: Waggle is a free, open-source Mac app where your AI agents ask you for decisions and reviews. Claude Code, Codex, the Claude app and Cowork send their questions through MCP. Each request shows what the agent needs, why it can't decide, the options and its recommendation. For UI work, click through the agent's prototype and pin comments on it. Your answer goes back to the same session, and the agent keeps going. Everything stays on your Mac.

records.name: Your Honest Year
records.tagline: Find out which of your goals are actually yours
records.description: Your Honest Year is a structured interview, about forty minutes, that asks where each of your ambitions came from, what it's costing you, and what you'd want if no one else had an opinion. Then it builds a year from only the answers that were actually yours: a 12-Month Roadmap, a 90-Day Sprint, three things at a time. One screen, not editable, so it stays the year you chose. $99, once. Not sure it's for you? The Clarity Audit is four questions, two minutes, free.

records.name: COMMIT: Dream Goal Planner
records.tagline: Turn Your Dreams Into Goals
records.description: Turn your dreams into goals. Assign them a deadline. Map the path ahead. Stay accountable. COMMIT is a focused goal-setting and accountability app designed to help you move your largest ambitions out of the “someday” category and into concrete, time-bound targets.

records.name: To-Do List Buddy
records.tagline: A to-do list for procrastinators
records.description: A to-do list for procrastinators: miss a deadline and your pixel pet loses a heart. Habits, Pomodoro and voice input on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Marko
records.tagline: Turn AI-written .md files into documents you can send
records.description: Claude, ChatGPT and Codex answer in Markdown. Marko opens thosemd files on your Mac as clean documents. Fix a passage yourself, or ask your AI and check the diff before anything changes. Keep themd, export a PDF, or put it in a team space where colleagues edit it with you. 14-day trial, Apple Silicon.

records.name: Inferbase AI
records.tagline: The control plane for AI models: route, govern, observe
records.description: One OpenAI-compatible API for every model. Send model: "auto" and each request is routed to the best model for the task on quality, cost and latency, with the reason kept on record. Assign routing policies, guardrails and rate limits to each key, use your own provider keys, cloud account or self-hosted endpoint, and fall back automatically when a provider fails.

records.name: Papias
records.tagline: The free form builder that drafts forms from a sentence
records.description: Papias is a form builder for the person running the thing: a club, a course, a small business, a survey. Free means unlimited forms and responses; we never count them. Describe a form in a sentence and it's drafted, then change it in words. Or photograph a paper form and it becomes the online one. One-click looks, your logo and fonts. Made by GestureLoop in Ireland, hosted in the EU, no trackers on your forms unless you add your own, and nobody's answers are sent to an AI.

records.name: ArtefactFlow
records.tagline: Everything you ship, tracked from build to production
records.description: One source of truth for every artefact, its versions and its SBOM. Know what's inside a release, whether it's vulnerable and where it runs, from CI to devices in the field. Built for the EU Cyber Resilience Act, API-first, flat price per organisation.

records.name: Poincaré
records.tagline: Liquidity that charges the trend, not the trader
records.description: A Uniswap v4 pool that detects real price trends on chain and charges a spread only to trades that push with them. Liquidity providers keep it. No oracle. Comes with an SDK and an MCP server so AI agents like Claude can read the market and plan orders.

records.name: Lume
records.tagline: An everyday iPhone camera with pro controls one tap away
records.description: A camera for iPhone that is quick by default, with pro controls one tap away. Record two cameras to two files at once, frame with rangefinder lines, shoot Apple Log 2 with your own LUT, and open the full camera from the Lock Screen. Built by a photographer.

records.name: QuantMarketAI
records.tagline: AI chart analysis from real candle data. Try it free.
records.description: Pick a crypto pair, stock or forex pair and get chart structure, support and resistance, and a score built from real candle data and indicators (RSI, EMA, MACD). Your first 3 analyses are free, no account needed. Pro adds entry, stop and target levels. Educational use only. Not financial advice.

records.name: Site Transformer
records.tagline: Ship SEO changes without a deploy
records.description: Site Transformer is a reverse proxy for technical SEO. Point a domain at it, then rewrite URLs and on-page markup in transit: URL aliases, DOM transforms, and an AI crawl that proposes the config. Changes go live in seconds, with no dev tickets.

records.name: Web3 for India
records.tagline: Web3 and blockchain explained for India
records.description: Plain-language explainers on Web3, blockchain and emerging technology, with an India focus. Understand the key ideas and what they mean for India, without the jargon or the hype. Built by The Bulletin Briefs.

records.name: FrameExtractor
records.tagline: Pull the best frames from any video
records.description: Turn screen recordings and video clips into sharp, ready-to-use stills. FrameExtractor finds unique frames and pre-selects the best ones, privately on your device. Free to try, with no account required. Pro adds unlimited videos, bulk ZIP downloads, high-quality JPG and lossless PNG exports, and on-device English transcripts on desktop. One payment, lifetime access.

records.name: Promptlyy
records.tagline: Browse 32,000+ ready-to-use AI prompts with live previews
records.description: Browse 32,000+ ready-to-use AI prompts with live previews: website and landing page prompts, UI components, 3D, image generation, marketing, coding and Claude skills. Copy free prompts or buy single ones in rand. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Lovable, v0 and Cursor.

records.name: QuackAPI
records.tagline: Send WhatsApp messages from your app. Connect in minutes.
records.description: QuackAPI is a simple REST API for WhatsApp. Scan a QR code to link your number, grab your API key and send or receive messages from your own app. It includes webhooks for incoming messages, connection health you can see, and a dashboard for message activity. Start on the free Starter plan and upgrade when you need more numbers or volume.

records.name: Flexiberry
records.tagline: The open-source HTTP client for sequential API workflows
records.description: Flexiberry is an open-source HTTP client & testing framework for sequential API workflows. New in v2: • Native Spring Boot starter: auto-introspects routes & generates end-to-end CRUD test suites • AST-based environments (dev/prod) & process.env variable fallbacks • Standalone API block execution in Web IDE & VS Code • Frictionless guest mode & README workspace docs

records.name: CitedEvidence
records.tagline: Research, write and cite with AI agents and real papers
records.description: CitedEvidence is a research workspace for students and researchers. New since our last launch: a Word-style AI editor (open and exportdocx, suggested edits, AI review comments, @cite), Deep Research run by a team of AI agents, the Proposal & Literature Studio that drafts full chapters with references, and Paper Feed with new papers on your topics daily. Every citation links to one of 250 million real papers.

records.name: Hopkey
records.tagline: Free command bar for Safari, Chrome, Brave, Edge, Vivaldi
records.description: Hopkey is a free command bar for Mac that works the same in Safari, Chrome, Brave, Edge, and Vivaldi. Press ⌘T and type: your open tabs in every window and Tab Group, your history and web search show in one list. Type a site and press Tab to search it. Press # for your tabs and history on the current site, $ for developer tools, and ⌘K to copy, pin or close a result. Your Spaces and Favorites import from Arc and work in every browser. No account, and your history stays on your Mac.

records.name: Contravise
records.tagline: Contracts, written and read in plain words
records.description: Describe the deal in a sentence and Contravise writes the full agreement. Upload any contract and ask about it: every answer points to the clause behind it. Edit by chat or by hand, accept changes one by one. Free to start, no card.

records.name: Amou
records.tagline: Remember what the people you love actually want.
records.description: Keep gift ideas for anyone, together with the friends who know them. They never need to sign up.

records.name: Redproof
records.tagline: Security check for apps built with Lovable, Bolt and Cursor
records.description: AI app builders ship working apps fast, and the same few holes again and again: tables anyone can read, secret keys in the browser, server functions anyone can call, fakeable payment webhooks. Redproof reads your code (never runs it) and explains each problem in plain words with the exact file and a fix prompt to paste back into your AI tool. Free launch score, a free check by URL with no GitHub needed, a Supabase RLS checker and a key checker that runs in your browser.

records.name: AMARACUS
records.tagline: Post-quantum cryptography API: keys, encrypt, sign, PKI
records.description: One API for managed keys, AES-256-GCM encryption, signing and hashing, plus post-quantum ML-KEM and ML-DSA and a hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM KEM. Includes a small PKI, audit log, TypeScript and Python SDKs and a CLI. Use it hosted, or self-host the source-available edition with 1,000 free operations. Not a FIPS 140-3 validated module.

records.name: Taskling: ADHD Daily Planner
records.tagline: The visual daily planner for ADHD brains
records.description: Taskling is a visual daily planner made for ADHD brains. Dump everything on your mind and Sprig, your planning buddy, turns it into tasks with times. See your whole day on a colorful timeline, break big tasks into tiny steps, run routines and use a gentle focus timer. Free on iPhone.

records.name: CueTools
records.tagline: Shot clocks, scoreboards and streaming for cue sports
records.description: Run your next cue sports match with a shot clock, race scoreboard and six-red shootout timer. Control linked displays from your phone, keep scores visible on TV, and stream from the mobile app with live match overlays. Available on iOS, Android, Fire TV and the web, with free core tools and optional Pro features.

records.name: ClearScreen
records.tagline: Three federal lists. One API call. Audit-ready answers.
records.description: ClearScreen screens any name against OFAC SDN, HHS-OIG LEIE and SAM.gov Exclusions in one call. Get MATCH, POTENTIAL or CLEAR with a confidence score, evidence and an audit_id — in under 200ms. Free for 100 checks a month, $0.02 per check after that, no credit card to start.

records.name: AGASTHY
records.tagline: See what breaks on your dev machine before you remove it
records.description: AGASTHY is a free, open-source desktop app that maps your developer machine: repos, runtimes, packages (Homebrew, npm, pip, cargo), AI tools and coding agents, linked in one graph. See what breaks before you remove something, track live Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions and their token cost, free disk space only from rebuildable folders, and give your agents a read-only MCP server. Local-first: no account, no telemetry. macOS first; Windows and Linux in preview.

records.name: ProofStack
records.tagline: Job site photo proof reports. Offline. No subscription.
records.description: ProofStack is field photo documentation for contractors, inspectors, roofers and restoration crews. Create a job, shoot photos straight into folders like Before, During and After, then build a clean PDF proof report on the spot. Every photo gets a SHA-256 fingerprint so you can show it hasn't been changed. Runs in your phone's browser, works offline, no account, no server. Free for 1 job and 30 photos. A one-time lifetime license removes the limits.

records.name: Card Mailer
records.tagline: Photo postcards mailed to every address on your list
records.description: Upload a photo, write a message and paste your address list or attach a spreadsheet. Card Mailer prints a 5×7 photo postcard for each person and mails it USPS First-Class. $4.99 a card, postage included, no minimum. You see the front, the back and every address before you pay, and you can cancel for a full refund until the send date. Works on the website, or from ChatGPT and Claude through its MCP server. US addresses only, up to 300 per order.

records.name: PadKeeper
records.tagline: The missing session manager for CoderPad
records.description: CoderPad sandbox pads eventually expire. PadKeeper backs up your practice sessions locally as you work, so you can restore them anytime or spin up a new pad right from the extension. Perfect for job seekers looking to sharpen their skills and get comfortable with the tools they'll use in interviews. Disclaimer: PadKeeper is an unofficial extension and isn't affiliated with CoderPad in any way.

records.name: Orbit X
records.tagline: Grow on X in your own voice, without living on X
records.description: Orbit X finds the posts in your niche taking off right now, while an early reply still gets seen, and Claude drafts replies and posts in your voice, never inventing facts. Plan a week that posts itself from your best hours, with an X-style composer and analytics. Pro adds a simulator that races two drafts before you post, launch campaigns, automations, leads and welcome DMs. X's official API, never your password. Works in Claude over MCP. 7 days free, then from $19/mo.

records.name: Gahmbit
records.tagline: Your OKRs aren't working and you know it.
records.description: Gahmbit is a free company town square for OKRs. Every teammate can read every objective, and missing coverage stays visible. Keep your tools. This is where commitments live. Optional AI uses prepaid credits and does not train on your data.

records.name: Money and Macros
records.tagline: Budget and nutrition macros in one app, one snap for each
records.description: Money & Macros puts your budget, macros, and recipes in one app, so you stop running a money app next to a food tracking and recipe app. Snap a restaurant check and the app tells you the tip and total, then calculates macros from the same pic. Snap a plate and macros are logged. Import recipes by picture or social share. Snap the pantry and fridge to get matching recipes. Tag business expenses by Schedule C line, then export the year. Optional read-only bank sync. Free 7-day Pro trial, no card.

records.name: JustRoadmap
records.tagline: A simple visual roadmap tool, now on web and mobile
records.description: JustRoadmap is a simple visual roadmap tool for web, iPhone, iPad and Android. Plan on a Week, Month or Year timeline in lanes, with milestones and dependencies. Status updates are always on; other extras are optional. Free to use while we're getting started.

records.name: AppReviewX
records.tagline: Swap private app feedback with other developers
records.description: AppReviewX is a feedback exchange for app developers. Test other developers' live Android, iOS, Windows and macOS apps, write private, structured feedback with a screenshot, and earn credits that buy feedback on your own app. No store ratings, reviews or installs are traded. Includes test groups for Google Play's closed-test requirement (12 testers, 14 days). Available in 30 languages.

records.name: Seaworthy
records.tagline: Pre-launch security check for AI-built apps
records.description: A pre-launch security check for apps built with Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable and Bolt. It finds leaked keys, open database rules, missing auth, unverified Stripe webhooks and risky agent and MCP setups, then explains each fix in plain English. Runs on your machine: your code never leaves it. No account needed: npx seaworthy-cli. Source-available (FSL-1.1-ALv2). An aid, not a security audit.

records.name: SaaS Niche Finder
records.tagline: Research your next SaaS idea with App Store evidence
records.description: Explore your next SaaS direction using US App Store listings. Start without a keyword, compare source-backed candidates, and check a premise before building. Free browsing and published research; paid plans add private keyword research and workflow tools. Listing claims and search estimates are research inputs, not proof of demand or revenue.

records.name: Alvseike
records.tagline: Run whole file jobs in your browser, saved to your own Drive
records.description: 60+ file tools that run in your browser: compress, convert and edit PDFs, images, video and audio. Your files are never uploaded to Alvseike. Open from and save to your own Google Drive, and run a whole job (edit, check, outline, deliver) as one folder that follows you from tool to tool and computer to computer. Made for print and ad work too: PDF preflight, text to outlines, an HTML5 ad builder and an ad inspector.

records.name: Bug-X Labs
records.tagline: Live GPS, battery & ride tracking for any e-bike
records.description: Bug-X Labs turns any e-bike into a connected one. Fit a supported GPS tracker (GT06, SinoTrack, TK103, Teltonika) or record rides from your phone, and see live location, battery health, trip history and theft alerts in our iOS and Android apps. Pair a Bluetooth BMS for cell-level battery data and climb the eco leaderboard. Running a fleet? The web console adds a live multi-bike map, geofencing, maintenance and API access. Free for riders.

records.name: StickerBombLab
records.tagline: Free AI Sticker Bomb Maker
records.description: One-click sticker bomb layout, full canvas control, and AI sticker generation from a text prompt. Export print-ready PNG for posters, apparel, and POD.

records.name: Fantasma v2
records.tagline: Visual Ghost theme builder, now with blocks and MCP
records.description: Fantasma is a visual theme builder for Ghost. In 2.0 you design the whole theme on one canvas, build sections from blocks, and connect Claude, Codex or Cursor over MCP. It exports a standard Ghost theme, and the builder is free.

records.name: Magneterie
records.tagline: Stream magnet links and MP4s right in your browser
records.description: Stream any magnet link or MP4 URL right in your browser — no downloads, no installs.

records.name: Viral Video
records.tagline: Your next viral video is one prompt away
records.description: AI video generator for viral TikToks, Reels & Shorts. 1-click remix daily trending templates or turn text & photos into HD video with Kling & Veo.

records.name: Your Move: Soccer Stories
records.tagline: Soccer drama in 1-minute episodes. You make the calls.
records.description: Soccer drama where you make the calls. Your Move is a collection of interactive soccer mini-series told in short vertical episodes. Each episode is about a minute long and ends on a choice. Pick what happens next and the series branches: the people around you remember what you did, and your story ends where your choices take it.

records.name: Can I Reverse Engineer It
records.tagline: See how hard any app is to rebuild, and where to start
records.description: Pick a product, get a teardown of what it takes to rebuild it: a 1-5 difficulty score, an MVP estimate in working days for one dev directing AI coding agents, the likely stack, open-source alternatives, and the hard problems you hit first. Every claim comes from the product's public pages, with quotes verified in code. Pro adds the data schema, API contract, build order, cost to run and a prompt pack for coding agents. 26 teardowns are live. Request any product and yours arrives in minutes.

records.name: Lean Operations Bundle
records.tagline: 5 Notion templates for stock, skills, SOPs, FMEA and DMAIC
records.description: Lean Operations Bundle is five Notion templates for the planning side of a lean operation: kanban inventory, a skills matrix, an SOP library, FMEA risk analysis and a DMAIC tracker. One-click buttons, guides and sample data. Built for Notion's free plan.

records.name: All Done
records.tagline: Free online tools for PDFs, resumes, images & more
records.description: All Done is a free toolbox of 50+ online tools for everyday work. Build ATS-friendly CVs, edit and merge PDFs, remove image backgrounds, upscale photos, draft text and slide decks with AI, and use calculators and converters. Everything runs in your browser with no sign-up, works on phone, tablet and desktop, and new tools ship every week.

records.name: LeedSheet AI
records.tagline: Upload a song, get an editable chord chart and stems
records.description: LeedSheet listens to a recording and writes an editable chord chart synced to the audio: chords, sections, key and tempo. Fix any chord, switch to Nashville numbers, split stems, slow it down, build setlists and export a clean PDF for rehearsal.

records.name: Who Wins
records.tagline: Predict the winner — Time Charts & Match Flow
records.description: Who Wins turns match details into clear sports predictions on Android — free winner verdicts, readable Time Chart periods, Match Flow momentum, and deeper premium insights for team and player sports. Saved charts stay encrypted on your device.

records.name: GTA 6 Interactive Map
records.tagline: A GTA 6 map where you share and discover Vice City's secrets
records.description: Explore GTA 6 locations, discover community suggestions, and share your own finds on an interactive map. Browse Vice City’s secrets and help build the map as the community explores.

records.name: Velqora PDF
records.tagline: Edit PDFs freely. No subscriptions, no limits.
records.description: Meet Velqora PDF, a free, offline PDF editor built to make working with documents simple and accessible. Edit text, annotate pages, organize documents and recognize text in scanned PDFs with offline OCR. No subscriptions, no accounts and no OCR credits. Your documents stay on your device. Available for Windows, macOS and Linux.

records.name: ScentLoop
records.tagline: India's marketplace for pre-owned perfume, with 0% fees
records.description: ScentLoop is India's marketplace for pre-owned perfume. Sell the bottles you don't wear in about a minute (real photos, a slider for how much is left, your price) and buy genuine perfume from fellow collectors. No listing fees, 0% commission. Every seller verifies their phone, every listing is checked before it goes live, and buyers and sellers chat and make offers right on ScentLoop. Plus a community forum and Fragrance Talk, a members-only group chat for perfume lovers.

records.name: Bumped
records.tagline: Passengers should not pay for airline overbooking.
records.description: Passengers should not pay for airline overbooking. Bumped is an independent passenger-advocacy project bringing public X posts about Etihad denied boarding and involuntary downgrades into one visible record. Read passenger experiences, follow the original sources, or add a public post so another voice isn't lost in a timeline. Free to browse and contribute, in English and Simplified Chinese.

records.name: Yakafa
records.tagline: AI quotes & e-invoicing for French tradespeople
records.description: For French businesses. Yakafa drafts your quotes with AI from a short brief or a voice note, and turns missed calls and WhatsApp messages into quote requests. Clients e-sign online and pay the deposit by card, reminders go out automatically, and invoices comply with France's 2026-2027 e-invoicing reform, sent through Openapi and Storecove, a platform approved by the DGFiP (French tax authority).

records.name: PrivaPDF
records.tagline: Zero-Knowledge PDF tools: 100% client-side privacy
records.description: PrivaPDF is a privacy-first suite of over 30 PDF tools running entirely in your browser with client-side WebAssembly. Merge, sign, redact, compress, and number sensitive documents without your files ever touching a server or cloud storage. Built for legal, healthcare, and privacy-conscious professionals.

records.name: Verspa
records.tagline: The AI demo agent that runs your real product, live
records.description: Your campaigns bring the buyer. Verspa meets them the moment they click with an AI buyer aware demo: it talks, listens and drives your real product live, deck and product in one conversation. It answers questions, handles objections and hands your team a briefed lead. Then it remembers. Verspa files the company under the buyer, so their history follows them when they change jobs. The website conversion platform for B2B software teams. Try it now: Verspa demos Verspa.

records.name: AUTX AI Visibility Check
records.tagline: Free check, no signup: does AI mention your business?
records.description: Free check, no signup: enter your business, and an OpenAI model answers three questions your customers ask. See whether it names you. The $49 report asks eight AI models and counts how often each names you, recommends you and cites your website. It grades you A to F. We ran it on our own company and got an F, 0 out of 100.

records.name: dynos-work
records.tagline: Self-auditing AI coding agent that learns your codebase
records.description: A plugin for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Describe a feature, approve a spec and plan, and it builds in parallel. Then independent agents check it for bugs, security issues, and spec gaps, and fix what they find. Every task adds prevention rules, so your 10th task beats your 1st. Works with permissions ON: allow one binary and you only see the decisions that are yours. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: QuickInspect.me
records.tagline: Safety work, rebuilt around your day
records.description: EHS app for inspections, permits, incidents, risk assessments, training and work instructions. 2.0 rebuilds every module: Home shows what needs you, permits show one next step, incidents fit on one page. Web, iOS and Android, in 30+ languages.

records.name: Talking with the Masters
records.tagline: Talk with history's great teachers — in their own words
records.description: Real, voiced conversations with history's great teachers — Nietzsche, Socrates, Marcus Aurelius, Lao Tzu, Maya Angelou, Carl Jung, Ernest Holmes, Alan Watts, Richard Feynman, and John von Neumann — each reconstructed from their own words. Teachers, not gods.

records.name: ChapterBooth
records.tagline: Record your audiobook. We make it studio-grade.
records.description: Studio sound for the audiobook you narrate yourself. Record or upload chapters: ChapterBooth removes noise, clicks and retakes, and masters every file to ACX specs. Free ACX Check, nothing uploaded. 45 free minutes, then $79 a book. Never an AI voice.

records.name: Steerglass
records.tagline: Fast desktop app for many Kubernetes clusters at once
records.description: Steerglass is a free, open source Kubernetes desktop client for macOS, Windows and Linux, built for people who run many clusters. Put the same resource from several clusters in one live table, see every cluster's health at a glance, and get logs, shell, port-forward and YAML built in. Native Rust core, ~10 MB, no account, no telemetry. Optional AI help with your own model, even a local one: it reads, explains and suggests, and never changes anything without your OK.

records.name: Sleep Songs
records.tagline: 12 calm, looping songs for sleep on iPhone, iPad and Mac
records.description: 12 professionally recorded, calm songs that loop seamlessly. Build playlists that play each song for as many minutes or loops as you like, then set a sleep timer. $4.99 once for iPhone, iPad and Mac. No ads, no subscription, no account. Free Lite version.

records.name: CVclick
records.tagline: Crea tu currículum gratis en PDF o Word
records.description: Crea tu currículum gratis y sin tarjeta: rellénalo paso a paso, elige entre 14 diseños con o sin foto y descárgalo en PDF con texto real o en Word editable.

records.name: Nestriq: Organizer & Planner
records.tagline: Nest it all in one place
records.description: Nestriq is a planner you shape yourself. Start from a template or a blank page, add the pieces you need, and keep your habits, budget, notes and reminders together. BRAIN DUMP Type whatever is on your mind and Nestriq sorts it. "Spent 12 on lunch" goes into your budget. "Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 10" becomes a reminder. "Add oat milk to grocery list" lands on your grocery list. Anything else waits in your Inbox until you get to it.

records.name: CommerceCopilot
records.tagline: AI analyst and PM that scope, write the SOW and run delivery
records.description: CommerceCopilot gives agencies and consultancies an AI business analyst and an AI project manager. The analyst reads the brief, Slack, Figma and client calls, asks about anything that is missing, and proposes a backlog with user stories and dependencies. Accept the tickets and it drafts the SOW. Once the SOW is signed, the PM agent tracks each requirement against it, flags risks and drafts weekly digests to approve. Tickets go to Jira or Notion. First brief free with a work email.

records.name: TapQuote
records.tagline: The AI quoting engine for independent contractors
records.description: TapQuote AI turns job-site photos and voice notes into branded, itemized quotes that customers can accept and pay — all from a contractor's phone.

records.name: Kiqora
records.tagline: Plan group trips together and split costs fairly
records.description: Pick the places you'd love to see and Kiqora builds every day around them, with walking times and real Google Maps data. Invite your group with one link, keep bookings offline, and split costs so everyone knows who owes what. Free on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: Trakisilo
records.tagline: Kanban, clipboard vault & time tracker — fully offline
records.description: Trakisilo combines your task board, clipboard manager, and time tracker into one desktop app that never touches the cloud. No account, no subscription, no network calls — your data stays on your machine. 2.0 ships a redesigned glass interface, a visual diagram canvas, math rendering, a smarter journal, and in-app viewers for Excel workbooks and Outlook mail attachments — openxlsx,xls,csv,eml, andmsg files right inside Trakisilo, no external app needed.

records.name: Merry Melody
records.tagline: Personalized Christmas songs from your shared memories
records.description: Turn a name and shared memories into an AI-generated Christmas song and a digital musical card. Review the lyrics, compare two versions, and hear free 30-second previews. Unlock one version for $14.99 or both for $24.99, plus applicable tax. Share the finished card by link; buyers can download the MP3.

records.name: TapPass: Loyalty Card Wallet
records.tagline: Store all loyalty cards free, plus geo-alerts & lists
records.description: All your loyalty cards in one place, for free. And for less than the price of a small coffee a month, you get geo-notifications whenever you're near a store with a saved card, plus a shared shopping list for everyone. Everything you need in one app. Never forget a loyalty card again, and ditch the bulky wallet.

records.name: RunCue
records.tagline: Plan events, coordinate your team, and run the show
records.description: RunCue brings event operations into one shared workspace. Coordinate tasks, vendors, budgets, guests and seating, then keep your team aligned with a shared run of show and event-day controls. Built for professional event teams, from planning through live execution and closeout.

records.name: RupeeTalk
records.tagline: Say what you spent. It stays on your phone.
records.description: RupeeTalk is a free offline expense tracker and budget manager for Android. Add expenses by voice, typing or UPI screenshot. No internet, no account, no ads.

records.name: Reserv IA
records.tagline: Never miss a restaurant booking call again
records.description: Reserv IA is an AI assistant that answers your restaurant’s calls and messages in natural Spanish and handles reservations automatically, so your team can focus on service. Built for independent restaurants in Spain.

records.name: TimedBuys.com
records.tagline: Never run out of the things you buy on repeat
records.description: Plan recurring buys from Amazon, AliExpress or any store. TimedBuys reminds you at the right moment, knows when it will arrive, and gives you a one-tap link to buy.

records.name: SIP Sentry
records.tagline: SIP Monitoring for Trunks, Registrars and SBCs
records.description: External SIP monitoring for MSPs and ITSPs. Checks SIP trunks, registrars and SBCs with real OPTIONS, REGISTER, TLS, DNS SRV and RTP test calls, and alerts only when something is actually wrong.

records.name: Biotrail
records.tagline: The free link in bio that takes 0% of your sales
records.description: A free link-in-bio page for creators, small businesses and freelancers: links, products, bookings and email signup in one place. We take 0% of your sales, analytics need no cookie banner, and your data leaves with you.

records.name: BackAgain?!
records.tagline: Stop opening distracting apps on autopilot
records.description: BackAgain?! pauses the iPhone apps you tend to open on autopilot and asks what you came to do. Pick a reason and get a short timed session. Reopen an app right away and it might roast you. Set daily limits and see what drives your Under Control score. Free for up to two apps, with optional Pro. No account required. Your activity history stays on your device.

records.name: Family Tree Design
records.tagline: Map your family across generations, with AI
records.description: Family Tree Design is a desktop app to map your family across generations. Build visual family trees, get AI BaZi analysis, hereditary risk alerts, blood type inheritance prediction, and smart name generation. All data stays local on your device — nothing is uploaded. Windows, macOS, and Linux, with a free trial.

records.name: SuitUp
records.tagline: Tailoring In Your Pocket
records.description: SuitUp is a Shanghai-based fashion-tech startup offering luxury, made-to-measure suits powered by AI body-scanning.

records.name: Pashacchi
records.tagline: A kids' camera for your phone. They shoot, you pick.
records.description: Pashacchi turns a phone into a camera for toddlers. Touching anywhere takes a photo. New photos wait inside the app, and only the ones you pick reach your photo library. No ads, no tracking, nothing leaves the phone. For Android and iPhone.

records.name: Bespoke
records.tagline: Describe the outfit. Get a sheet tailors trust.
records.description: Getting clothes stitched in India breaks at one step: the words. Say what you want in English or Hinglish, typed or spoken. Bespoke asks only what's missing, reads the pictures you pin, and hands you a tailor sheet in English or Hindi. Free.

records.name: SFtown
records.tagline: The internet’s smallest San Francisco
records.description: A little San Francisco for startups and the people behind them. Claim a lot for your company or for yourself, grab a coffee, ride the cable car and say hi. Everyone you see here is a real person, live right now.

records.name: ThinkaBit
records.tagline: Teach kids 7–12 how AI works and how to spot fakes
records.description: ThinkaBit is a game for kids 7–12 about how AI works. They teach Sparky, a robot pet, and catch Glitch's fakes across five worlds. No ads, no tracking, parent PIN. Free on iOS and Android, in 8 languages. Family plan from $3.99/mo; $14.99 first year at launch.

records.name: Eldrin
records.tagline: One lamp. Three Lanterns. Bring back the light.
records.description: A text adventure for iPhone, with Android arriving Dec 1. Wake in the drowned Hollowmere and find the three Lanterns of the Deep.

records.name: EasyPlanning
records.tagline: Tour guide scheduling for tour operators and DMCs
records.description: EasyPlanning replaces spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for tour operators. Plan every departure in one calendar, keep a database of guides with languages, cities and availability, let guides apply for open tours, handle last-minute cancellations, and report on fill rate, guide hours and costs. Guides use it for free. Comes with an MCP server so you can run operations from Claude or other AI assistants. 14-day free trial, no credit card.

records.name: vibegif
records.tagline: public domain gallery of 1300 gifs and animated webp
records.description: public domain gallery of 1300 gifs and animated webp, free to use and hot link (CC0)

records.name: Bowerbird

records.tagline: Know your profit before you sell across six marketplaces
records.description: SellerFeePro helps US online sellers estimate marketplace fees and net profit before listing. Use calculators for Etsy, eBay, Whatnot, Poshmark, Mercari and Depop, or compare all six side by side. Explore fee breakdowns, break-even prices and Etsy pricing. Free to use, with no account required. Results are estimates; marketplace rules and item eligibility vary.

records.name: LedgerPath
records.tagline: LedgerPath — Clean books, clear cash, better decisions
records.description: LedgerPath helps founder-led businesses turn clean monthly books into practical cash-flow, margin, and growth decisions. It combines monthly bookkeeping, management accounts, KPI dashboards, and fractional CFO support—so founders can see what is happening and decide what to do next.

records.name: QuotPay
records.tagline: Proposals clients sign digitally — invoices in one click
records.description: Proposal and invoicing software for freelancers. Share a proposal as a link, your client signs online, and the invoice is created automatically – ready to send in one click. • Online signature with timestamp and view tracking • E-invoices (XRechnung & ZUGFeRD) on every plan • Reminders, recurring invoices, SEPA direct debit (Pro) • DATEV export, accountant access, Lexware (Pro) • Teams, API & webhooks (Business) • 5 languages · Free: 3 proposals/month
